Philip Yakovlevich MELCER ( Meltser ), Russian of Jewish origin, was born on August 18, 1898 in Vilno Province, Russia. According to his own statement, he left Russia for China in 1918 and after a short stay in Harbin proceeded to Shanghai. Here he claims to have been engaged in commercial pursuits for about two years, after which he left for Harbin. According to him, he worked from 1920 to 1922 as a representative of Dunlop Rubber Company for the Chinese Eastern Railway in Harbin and from 1922 to 1923 - as a representative of various American firms in Dairen, after which for about five years he resided in Tientsin where he was engaged in real estate business and also operated his own factory - the "Orthophone Company", manufacturers of Radios and Gramophones. He returned to Shanghai in 1929. In 1930-1932 he had an office at 14 Kiukiang Road, Room 17-B, under the style of "Philip Melcer, Insurance and Investment Agent" and concurrently worked as an agent for Sun Life Assurance Company of Canada, after which he worked in the same capacity for Crown China Company, 113 Kiukiang Road. He is still connected with the latter company.

Until 1934 he was registered as a Lithuanian citizen. Following an investigation carried out by a Lithuanian Government official in 1934 regarding the activities of a certain Mr. Kotyl-Kotylius, former Honorary Consul for Lithuania in Harbin, many of the "certificates of nationality" issued by the latter, including that of Melcer's, were declared invalid. 菲利普·雅科夫列维奇·梅尔策（Meltser），俄籍犹太人，1898年8月18日出生于俄罗斯维尔诺省。据其自述，他于1918年离开俄罗斯前往中国，在哈尔滨短暂停留后抵达上海。他声称在此从事商业活动约两年，随后前往哈尔滨。据称，1920年至1922年间，他在哈尔滨担任邓禄普橡胶公司（Dunlop Rubber Company）在中东铁路的代表；1922年至1923年间，在大连担任多家美国公司的代表；此后在天津居住约五年，从事房地产业务，并经营自己的工厂——“奥托风公司”（Orthophone Company），制造收音机和留声机。他于1929年返回上海。1930年至1932年间，他在九江路14号17-B室设有办事处，字号为“菲利普·梅尔策，保险与投资代理”，同时兼任加拿大永明人寿保险公司（Sun Life Assurance Company of Canada）的代理，之后又以同样身份受雇于九江路113号的冠华公司（Crown China Company）。他目前仍与该公司保持联系。

直至1934年，他登记为立陶宛公民。1934年，立陶宛政府官员就前驻哈尔滨立陶宛名誉领事科蒂尔-科蒂柳斯（Kotyl-Kotylius）先生的活动进行调查后，由后者签发的许多“国籍证书”，包括梅尔策的在内，均被宣布无效。随后，梅尔策通过慕尔鸣路俄国侨民委员会向上海市政府警察局登记为俄国侨民（

Translation from the "Novosti Dnia" ( Russian Daily News),
September 21,1938.

P.J. MELCER DEPORTED FROM JAPAN

Philip Yakovlevich Melcer,Russian emigrant, and his wife
arrived in Shanghai from Yokohama aboard the s.s." Empress of
Asia". They were deported from Japan.
According to the Japanese newspaper " Japan Advertiser",
P.J.Melcer was arrested by the Japanese Police at the "New
Grand Hotel",Tokyo, in 1929 on a charge of fraud and subse-
quently was deported to Shanghai.
Recently the police of Kanagawa Prefecture ascertained
that he together with his young wife had again arrived to Ja-
pan.
An order of deportation was issued against him and he was
deported in the s.s. " Empress of Asia".

Translation from the "Novosti Dnia" ( Russian Daily News),
October 6,1938.

P.J. MELCER DENIES THAT HE WAS DEPORTED FROM JAPAN.

Letter to the Editor.

Sir,
I was informed that on 21/9 you published an
article which reflects unfavourably on my name. In order to re-
fute the allegations contained in that article I wish to make
the following statement of facts:-
Neither during many years of my residence here,
nor in any other country was ever any charge openly preferred
against me before a court. This will be made clear by the fol-
lowing statement I made at the Consulate on September 24,1938:-
" In May,1938 I applied for a visa to North Chi-
na and Japan. I was granted the visa to North China and was in-
formed that permission for granting to me a visa to Japan would
be applied for. In July the latter visa was also granted to
me.
" Officials in Yokohama did not believe my sta-
tement regarding the details of circumstances under which the
visa for Japan had been granted to me as, according to them,
permission to issue such visas must be authorised by the Gover-
nor's Office at Yokohama. It was also pointed out to me that
the visa had been granted to me for two months only,after the
expiration of which period I must depart from Japan. I complied
with the latter request.
" Speaking in his private capacity,one of the
officials in reply to my insistent questions said that alle-
gedly I was charged with leaving unpaid a debt of $ 40 in Yo-
kohama in 1929. I said that no one ever presented to me any
demands for the payment of any debts.
In addition I can state that I did not stay at
the New Grand Hotel and I fully paid for my tickets.
I intend to submit the above facts for verifi-
cation before an open court and,if possible, to prosecute the
persons who areresponsible for the libellous statement".

P.J. Melcer.

Editor's note:
Our article regarding Mr. Melcer contained a
report concerning the deportation of Mr. Melcer and his wife
from Japan, in the s.s. "Empress of Asia". This report was
taken from the "Japan Advertiser" in which it is stated that
the information regarding the deportation was received from
the police of Kanagawa Prefecture.

译自1938年9月21日《新闻日报》（Novosti Dnia，即《俄罗斯日报》）。

P.J. 梅尔策被驱逐出日本

俄侨菲利普·雅科夫列维奇·梅尔策及其妻子乘坐“亚细亚皇后”号轮船从横滨抵达上海。他们是被日本驱逐出境的。
据日文报纸《日本广告报》（Japan Advertiser）报道，P.J. 梅尔策曾于1929年因涉嫌欺诈在东京“新格兰德酒店”（New Grand Hotel）被日本警察逮捕，随后被驱逐至上海。
近期，神奈川县警察厅查明，他与其年轻妻子再次抵达日本。
当局对他发出了驱逐令，他已被“亚细亚皇后”号轮船驱逐出境。

译自1938年10月6日《新闻日报》（Novosti Dnia，即《俄罗斯日报》）。

P.J. 梅尔策否认被驱逐出日本。

致编辑的信。

先生：
我获悉贵报于9月21日刊登了一篇损害我名誉的文章。为了驳斥该文中的指控，我愿陈述以下事实：
无论在我多年居留此地期间，还是在任何其他国家，从未有任何法庭对我公开提出指控。以下我于1938年9月24日在领事馆所作的声明将澄清此事：
“1938年5月，我申请前往华北和日本的签证。我获得了华北签证，并被告知将为我申请日本签证。7月，我也获得了后者签证。
“横滨的官员不相信我关于获得日本签证具体情况的说辞，因为据他们称，签发此类签证必须得到横滨总督府的授权。他们还指出，发给我的签证有效期仅为两个月，期满后我必须离开日本。我遵守了这一要求。
“一位官员以私人身份回答我一再追问时说，据称我1929年在横滨欠下40美元债务未还。我说从来没有人向我提出过任何偿还债务的要求。
此外，我可以声明，我并未入住新格兰德酒店，且我已全额支付了我的船票费用。
我打算将上述事实提交公开法庭核实，并在可能的情况下，起诉那些应对这一诽谤性陈述负责的人。”

P.J. 梅尔策。

编者按：
我们关于梅尔策先生的文章包含了一则关于梅尔策先生及其妻子乘坐“亚细亚皇后”号轮船被驱逐出日本的报道。该报道引自《日本广告报》，其中称驱逐信息来自神奈川县警察厅。

Subject Mr. F. Pordes, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by C. Clausen

Friedrich PORDES, Austrian citizen of Jewish origin,
was born on April 30, 1916 at Vienna. He holds passport
No. 007307 issued on 30-6-38 by the police authorities in
Vienna, valid for six months.

According to his own statement, he graduated from the
University of Vienna in March, 1938 and is a chemist by pro-
fession. He left Vienna for Copenhagen in the beginning of
September, 1938 and after a short stay in that city proceeded
to Marseilles where he embarked the s.s. "Aramis" with the
destination for Shanghai. He arrived here on 26-11-38 and at
present resides at 23 Tifeng Road. He is registered with the
Jewish Refugees Relief Committee ( Reg. card No. 16 ).

Enquiries at the local German Consulate-General show
that there is on record a communication from the Vienna Po-
lice to the effect that up to the time when the above pas-
port was issued to Pordes nothing was known against him either
criminally or politically.

While in Shanghai he did not come to the notice of
the Municipal Police in connection with any activities of an
undesirable nature.

                                G. Prokofiev
                                D. S. I.

弗里德里希·波尔德斯（Friedrich PORDES），奥地利公民，犹太裔，
于1916年4月30日出生于维也纳。他持有维也纳警方当局
于1938年6月30日签发的第007307号护照，有效期为六个月。

据其自述，他于1938年3月毕业于维也纳大学，职业为化学家。
他于1938年9月初离开维也纳前往哥本哈根，在该市短暂停留后
前往马赛，并在那里登上驶往上海的“阿拉米斯”号（s.s. "Aramis"）轮船。
他于1938年11月26日抵达此处，现居住于提丰路23号。他已在
犹太难民救济委员会登记（登记卡号 16）。

向本地德国总领事馆查询显示，记录中有一份来自维也纳警方的
函件，内容大意是：在上述护照签发予波尔德斯之时，并未发现
其有任何刑事或政治方面的不良记录。

在上海期间，他未因任何不良性质的活动而引起工部局警务处的注意。

                                G. Prokofiev

Subject E.N. Caro , applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D. S. Pavloff. Forwarded by C Crawford .

Evgeny Nickolaevitch CARO , Russian , was born on
May 28 , 1917 at Chita , Siberia. He is reported to have
left the U.S.S.R. together with his mother in 1926 and
subsequently resided in Tientsin. He arrived in Shanghai
from that city in 1930 and during the same year entered
the Junior Public School in which he studied up to 1933.
From September 1933 to November 1935 he studied in the
Public and Thomas Hanbury School.

In May 1936 he was engaged by Andersen , Meyer & Co
Ltd. as an apprentice and at present holds the position
of a supervisor in their Motor and Appliance Shop.

The applicant is registered with the Police Bureau
of the City Government of Shanghai as a Russian emigrant ,
( Reg. Cert. No 22345 issued on 29-7-37.).

While in Shanghai he did not come to the notice
of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable nature.

Date January 19, 19 39.

Subject Application for a certificate of character : Mrs. Esther Garwood
COUCH (American)
Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by C. Crawford C.J.

At 4 p.m., 19.1.39, Mr. David H. Couch, engineer
employed in the Riverside Station, Shanghai Power Company,
came to the Special Branch and made verbal application for
a certificate of character in respect of his wife, Mrs.
Esther Garwood Couch (American), covering the period of her
residence in Shanghai, which is required by the Argentine
Government in connection with her proposed passage through
Argentine in the near future. Mr. Couch mentioned that
his wife expects to sail from Shanghai on 23.1.39, aboard
the K.P.M. s.s. "TEGELBERG" and requested that the matter
should be expedited in order that she could leave on the
date scheduled.

Enquiries show that there is nothing on record against
Mrs. Couch either in the records of the Shanghai Municipal
Police or the French Police. She arrived in Shanghai on
23.10.34 and from that date lived with her husband in a
boarding house at Lane 1220, House 10, Avenue Road, till
6.3.35, when she moved to 101 Route Magniny, French
Concession, where she lived with her husband till August,
1936, when she moved to Plum Well Villas, Amherst Road.
She resided at the latter address till the outbreak of the
Sino-Japanese hostilities in August 1937, when she moved
to Apt. 54, 382 Route Cohen, French Concession where she
still resides. Her husband is an employee of the Shanghai
Power Company.

Mrs. Couch intends to accompany her husband as far
as Durban, South Africa, from where she will proceed

1939年1月19日下午4时，受雇于上海电力公司江边电站的工程师
大卫·H·库奇（David H. Couch）先生来到特务科，口头申请为其妻子
埃丝特·加伍德·库奇夫人（美国人）出具一份涵盖其在上海居住期间的
品行证明书，阿根廷政府因其近期拟经阿根廷过境而要求提供此证明。
库奇先生提到，他的妻子预计于1939年1月23日乘坐
荷兰皇家邮船公司（K.P.M.）的“特格尔贝格”号（s.s. "TEGELBERG"）轮船
从上海启航，并请求加快办理此事，以便她能按预定日期离境。

查询显示，在上海公共租界工部局警务处或法国警察局的记录中，
均无针对库奇夫人的不良记录。她于1934年10月23日抵达上海，
从该日起与丈夫居住在爱文义路1220弄10号的寄宿舍，直至
1935年3月6日，随后搬至法租界迈尼尼路101号，与丈夫居住至
1936年8月，之后搬至安赫斯特路 Plum Well Villas（音译：普拉姆韦尔别墅）。
她居住在后一地址直至1937年8月中日敌对行动爆发，当时她搬至
法租界高恩路382号54室公寓，至今仍居住于此。她的丈夫是
上海电力公司的雇员。

库奇夫人打算陪同丈夫前往南非德班，从那里她将

REPORT
Date January 20, 1939

Subject Mr. V.M. Ivanoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. S.I.

Vladimir Mihailovich IVANOFF, Russian, was born on
June 6, 1899 at Nikolsk-Ussuryisk, Maritime Province, Russia. He
is reported to have escaped from the U.S.S.R. to Japan in 1924
and to have arrived in Shanghai in October of the same year.

From 1-3-26 to 31-12-27 he was employed as an assis-
tant engineer at the Briquetting Factory of the Shanghai Exploi-
tation & Development Co., Ichang Road, and from 19-4-28 to 1932 -
as a kennel man at the Luna Park ( Greyhound Racing Association ).
For the following 3 years he worked as a dog trainer at the Ca-
nidrome and from 1935 has been employed with Keylock and Pratt,
Surgery & Infirmary, 645 Gordon Road, as an assistant.

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
Moulmein Road, and with the Shanghai City Government Police Bu-
reau. For the past four years he has been residing at House 55,
Lane 685 Gordon Road, together with his wife, Mrs. Christina Iphi-
povna Ivanoff nee Ochkaloff, born on 24-7-1899 at Kiev, Russia.
Mrs Ivanoff is reported to have been residing in Shanghai since
1924. From 1931 to November, 1934, when she married the applicant,
she was employed as an inspectress at a factory of the Tobacco
Products Corporation in Shanghai.

The applicant's brother, Victor M. Ivanoff is in Tsing-
tao at present where for the past four years he has been employ-
ed with the B.A.T. Company. Their sister is the wife of Sub-Ins-
pector I.V. Goloobkoff of the Municipal Police.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records con-
cerning the applicant or any member of his family.

G. Prokofiev.
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由高级督察 C. Crawford 转呈。

弗拉基米尔·米哈伊洛维奇·伊万诺夫（Vladimir Mihailovich IVANOFF），俄国人，1899年6月6日出生于俄罗斯滨海省乌苏里斯克（Nikolsk-Ussuryisk）。据报他于1924年从苏联逃往日本，并于同年10月抵达上海。

1926年3月1日至1927年12月31日，他在宜昌路上海兴业开发公司（Shanghai Exploitation & Development Co.）的砖厂担任助理工程师；1928年4月19日至1932年，他在月园（Luna Park，即赛狗会）担任犬舍管理员。随后的三年里，他在逸园跑狗场（Canidrome）担任驯犬师；自1935年起，他在戈登路645号凯洛克与普拉特诊所及医务室（Keylock and Pratt, Surgery & Infirmary）担任助理。

他在莫尔美路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局均有登记。过去四年间，他与妻子克里斯蒂娜·伊菲波芙娜·伊万诺娃（Christina Iphipovna Ivanoff，婚前姓 Ochkaloff）一同居住在戈登路685弄55号。其妻1899年7月24日出生于俄罗斯基辅。据报伊万诺娃夫人自1924年起便居住在上海。从1931年至1934年11月（她与申请人结婚之时），她在上海烟草制品公司（Tobacco Products Corporation）的一家工厂担任女监工。

申请人的兄弟维克多·M·伊万诺夫（Victor M. Ivanoff）目前在青岛，过去四年受雇于英美烟草公司（B.A.T. Company）。他们的姐妹是工部局警务处副督察 I.V. Goloobkoff（音译）的妻子。

工部局警务处的档案中，没有关于申请人或其任何家庭成员的记录。

G. Prokofiev.
副督察

D. C. （特务科）。

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C [Signature]

Miss Maria Ivanovna STEPANENKO, Russian, born on
July 8,1909 at Harbin. She is reported to have arrived in
Shanghai in November,1930 from Harbin where,according to her
own statement, she had worked in a pharmacy for a period as an
apprentice pharmaceutist. In Shanghai she is known to have
worked as a dancing partner at the Del Monte Cafe until a
couple of years ago, after which she appears to have been co-
habiting with or supported by a certain Dr. Karl Elster,
Austrian of Jewish origin, a local medical practitioner who
has his office at 170 Kiangsi Road ( Hamilton House) and re-
sides at 1202 Avenue Joffre,Apt. 56.

In August,1938 she applied to the local Netherlands Con-
sulate-General for a visa for admission into the Netherlands
Indies. In this connection she intimated that after a short
stay in that country she intended to join Dr. Elster in Hong-
kong where their marriage was planned to take place. For some
reasons,however, neither her trip to the Netherlands Indies,
nor her intended marriage have taken place.

Miss Nina Ivanovna STEPANENKO,sister of the above, was
born on January 1,1913 at Harkov,South Russia. A pharmaceutist
by occupation she is reported to have arrived in Shanghai from
Harbin in 1932. Here she was employed in her professional ca-
pacity in various local pharmacies including the Russian Phar-
macy ,1240 Rue Lafayette ( 1933-1934), St. George Pharmacy,
1599 Bubling Well Road ( 1934 - 1937) and Luebbert's Pharmacy,
169 Nanking Road ( in July,1938). At present she is unemploy-
ed and resides at 360 Embankment Building,Apt. 231, together
with her mother, Mrs Maria Vassilievna KROTOFF, born 22-7-1879
at Harkov. Mrs Krotoff,who appears to be a divorcee, is re-

玛丽亚·伊万诺芙娜·斯捷潘年科（Maria Ivanovna STEPANENKO）小姐，俄国人，1909年7月8日出生于哈尔滨。据报她于1930年11月从哈尔滨抵达上海。据她自己陈述，她在哈尔滨曾在一家药店做过一段时间的药剂学徒。在上海，众所周知她曾在德尔蒙特咖啡馆（Del Monte Cafe）担任舞伴，直到几年前，此后她似乎与一位卡尔·埃尔斯特（Karl Elster）医生同居或由其供养。埃尔斯特医生是奥地利籍犹太人，本地执业医师，诊所在江西路170号（汉密尔顿大厦），寓所位于霞飞路1202号56室。

1938年8月，她向当地荷兰总领事馆申请前往荷属东印度的签证。在此过程中，她表示在该国短暂停留后，打算去香港与埃尔斯特医生汇合，并计划在那里结婚。然而，出于某些原因，她既未前往荷属东印度，也未成婚。

尼娜·伊万诺芙娜·斯捷潘年科（Nina Ivanovna STEPANENKO）小姐，上述人士之妹，1913年1月1日出生于俄罗斯南部哈尔科夫（Harkov）。她是一名药剂师，据报于1932年从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此地，她以专业身份受雇于多家本地药店，包括拉斐特路1240号的俄国药店（1933-1934年）、静安寺路1599号的圣乔治药店（St. George Pharmacy，1934-1937年）以及南京路169号的吕伯特药店（Luebbert's Pharmacy，1938年7月）。目前她失业，与母亲玛丽亚·瓦西里耶芙娜·克罗托夫（Maria Vassilievna KROTOFF）夫人一同居住在百老汇路360号河滨大厦231室。克罗托夫夫人出生于1879年7月22日，地点为哈尔科夫。克罗托夫夫人看似离异，居——

Subject Communication dated 11-1-39 from the British Consulate-General
concerning E.F.Horowitz, applicant for a visa to enter Australia.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Bayne

Efraim Fischel HOROWITZ (Erwin Horowitz), former
Austrian citizen of Jewish origin, born on 10-1-1907 at
Brody, Galicia. He holds passport No. 26C5 issued on November
22, 1938 by the Vienna Police in which it is stated that
he is a person without nationality. He is a commercial
employee by occupation.

It appears that he left Vienna for Trieste on 3-12-38
and on 6-12-38 embarked the s.s. "Conte Rosso" with the
destination to Shanghai, arriving in this city on December
31, 1938.

At present he resides at Lane 24 Ward Road, House 11.
He is registered with the local Committee for Relief to
European Refugees (Reg. card No. 160).

Horowitz is in possession of a certificate dated
11-11-38 (No. 11.2006/38) issued by the Vienna Police to
the effect that while in that city he did not come to their
notice.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning this individual.

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

埃夫莱姆·菲谢尔·霍罗维茨（Efraim Fischel HOROWITZ）（又名 Erwin Horowitz），前奥地利公民，犹太裔，1907年1月10日出生于加利西亚布罗迪（Brody）。他持有维也纳警察局于1938年11月22日签发的第26C5号护照，其中注明他为无国籍人士。他的职业是商业职员。

看来他于1938年12月3日离开维也纳前往的里雅斯特，并于1938年12月6日登上“罗索伯爵号”（Conte Rosso）轮船，目的地为上海，于1938年12月31日抵达本市。

目前他居住在华德路24弄11号。他在当地欧洲难民救济委员会登记（登记卡号160）。

霍罗维茨持有一份日期为1938年11月11日（编号11.2006/38）由维也纳警察局出具的证明，表明他在该市期间未引起警方注意。

工部局警务处的档案中，没有关于此人的记录。

A. Prokofiev
副督察

D.C. （特务科）。

Subject Communication dated 11-1-39 from the British Consulate-General
concerning E. Engel, applicant for a visa to enter Australia.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford

Ernst ENGEL, German of Jewish origin, born on August
27, 1898 at Baden near Vienna. He holds passport No. 31892
issued on 5-10-38 by the Vienna Police, valid for one year and
good for travelling to France, Great Britain, Jugoslavia,
Australia, South America and the Far East. In this passport
his occupation is stated as that of a commercial employee.
According to his own statement, he left Vienna for
Trieste on 2-12-38 and on 7-12-38 embarked the s.s. "Conte
Rosso" with the destination to Shanghai, arriving in this city
on 31-12-38. After staying at the Embankment Building for
about one week, he removed to his present address - 159 Avenue
Haig, House 7, where he resides together with his wife, Mrs.
Louise Engel nee Fischer, born on 9-7-1900 at Vienna and their
daughter Eva, born 30-7-27 at the same city (passports Nos.
31893 and 31894, respectively, issued on 5-10-38 at Vienna).
Mr. and Mrs. Engel are in possession of certificates
of good character issued by the Vienna Police on 26-10-38
(Nos. K.B. 29675 and K.B. 29666).
It appears that in July, 1938 Mr. Engel applied for
an immigration visa to Australia, and that his application
was not approved (letter dated 4-11-38 from Department of the
Interior, Canberra, A.C.T., No. 38/20574).
Nothing detrimental is known regarding these persons
at the local German Consulate-General and while in Shanghai
they did not come to Police notice.

D.C. (Sp. Br.)
24/1

D.C. (Special Branch).

G. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由 C. Crawford 转呈

恩斯特·恩格尔（Ernst ENGEL），德国人，犹太裔，1898年8月27日出生于维也纳附近的巴登（Baden）。他持有维也纳警察局于1938年10月5日签发的第31892号护照，有效期一年，适用于前往法国、英国、南斯拉夫、澳大利亚、南美和远东地区旅行。在该护照中，他的职业被列为商业职员。据他自己陈述，他于1938年12月2日离开维也纳前往的里雅斯特，并于1938年12月7日登上“罗索伯爵号”（Conte Rosso）轮船，目的地为上海，于1938年12月31日抵达本市。在河滨大厦（Embankment Building）停留约一周后，他搬至现址——海格路159号7号，与妻子路易丝·恩格尔（Louise Engel，婚前姓 Fischer，1900年7月9日出生于维也纳）及女儿伊娃（Eva，1927年7月30日出生于同一城市）同住（护照号码分别为31893和31894，均于1938年10月5日在维也纳签发）。
恩格尔夫妇持有维也纳警察局于1938年10月26日签发的品行良好证明（编号分别为 K.B. 29675 和 K.B. 29666）。
看来恩格尔先生曾于1938年7月申请移民澳大利亚的签证，但未获批准（堪培拉内政部1938年11月4日来信，编号 38/20574）。
当地德国总领事馆方面未发现有关这些人的不利记录，且他们在上海期间未引起警方注意。

D.C. （特务科）
1月24日

D.C. （特务科）。

G. Prokofiev
副督察

Nikolai Alexandrovich HRAPOFF, Russian, born on
April 24, 1915 at Irkutsk, Siberia. He is reported to have ar-
rived in Shanghai from Vladivostok in 1923. From 1924 to 1930
he attended the Commercial School of the Russian Orthodox
Confraternity, after which he studied in the French Munici-
pal College for one year. From February, 1933 he has been
employed with the China General Omnibus Co., Ltd, as a mechanic.
He is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Com-
mittee, Moulmein Road, and with the Shanghai City Government
Police Bureau and at present resides at Passage 100, House 3,
Rue Paul Henry together with his parents, Mr. and Mrs. A.K.
Hrapoff. His elder brother, Eugene A. Hrapoff, 25, has been
employed by the same company as a mechanic for over six years.
While in Shanghai neither the applicant nor any
member of his family came to the notice of the Municipal Po-
lice in connection with any activities of an undesirable na-
ture.

A. Prokofiev

D. C. (Sp. Br.)

The only thing that worries me in giving such
certificates to THIRD PARTIES is that a lawyer may
apply, without authority, in regard to a person whom
he suspects of having a criminal record. Our refusal
will give him the tip he wants. I therefore feel
we should only supply DIRECT OR to PROVED LEGAL
REPRESENTATIVES.

Sd.( K.M. Bourne).

of Jan. 27, 1939.

safeguard us. No replies to third parties will be
drafted where the necessary proof is lacking.

concerning P.V. Gelter, applicant for a visa to Australia.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Pavel Vladimirovich GELTER, Russian, born on
January 15,1897 at Tumen, Tobolsk Province,Siberia. Formerly
a junior war time officer in the "White Russian" army in Sibe-
ria,he is reported to have left Vladivostok for Manchuria via
Gensan in 1922 together with the remnants of the army and for
the following nine years to have resided in Harbin. He claims
to have graduated from the Harbin Polytechnic Institute ( Ci-
vil Engineering Department ) in February,1931. In October of
the same year he arrived in Shanghai. Here he was employed with
A.G. Chibunovsky & Co., Heating and Sanitary Engineers,from
1932 to 1935 . For the past two years he has been connected
with Andersen,Meyer & Company,Ltd.

Mrs Galina Pavlovna GELTER nee Doroshenko, wife
of the above, was born on 15-2-1907 at Piatigorsk,Caucasus,
Russia. She is reported to have been residing in Shanghai
since 1932.

Mr. & Mrs Gelter are registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road, and with the Shanghai Ci-
ty Government Police Bureau ( Reg. 7016 ) . At present they
reside at 1560 Avenue Joffre, Apt. D-2.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning these persons.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

帕维尔·弗拉基米罗维奇·盖尔特（Pavel Vladimirovich GELTER），俄罗斯人，1897年1月15日出生于西伯利亚托博尔斯克省秋明。他曾是西伯利亚“白俄”军队的一名初级战时军官，据报他于1922年随残部经元山（Gensan）离开符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）前往满洲，并在随后的九年里居住在哈尔滨。他声称于1931年2月毕业于哈尔滨工业大学（土木工程系）。同年10月，他抵达上海。在此，他于1932年至1935年间受雇于 A.G. Chibunovsky 公司，担任供暖与卫生工程师。过去两年，他与安得生·梅尔公司（Andersen, Meyer & Company, Ltd.）有业务关联。

上述人士之妻，加林娜·帕夫洛夫娜·盖尔特（Galina Pavlovna GELTER），娘家姓多罗申科（Doroshenko），1907年2月15日出生于俄罗斯高加索地区的皮亚季戈尔斯克。据报她自1932年起居住在上海。

盖尔特夫妇在莫尔尼路（Moulmein Road）的俄罗斯侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局（注册号 7016）均有登记。目前他们居住于霞飞路1560号 D-2 公寓。

工部局警务处记录中关于这些人员没有任何不良记载。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
警探长

Subject F. Pollak, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Gault

Felix POLLAK, German citizen of Jewish origin,
born on December 23, 1896 at Vienna. He holds passport
No. 25606 issued by the Vienna Police on 15-9-38, valid for
one year and good for travelling to France, Great Britain,
United States, Japan and China. In this passport his occu-
pation is stated as that of a commercial employee.

It appears that he left Vienna for the Far East
via Siberia on September 30, 1938. On 18-10-38 he arrived in
Shanghai from Dairen in the s.s. "Tsingtao Maru" together with
his wife.

According to his own statement, he is a partner
in the Vienna Tailoring Co, 150 Kiukiang Road, Room 303, which
was established about two months ago by one J. Sinai, also a
German Jew, who arrived in Shanghai from Germany recently.

At present he resides at 2 Route Delastre together
with his wife, Mrs Paula Pollak nee Kornmehl, born on 1-12-1909
at Vienna.

Nothing detrimental is known at the local German
Consulate-General regarding these persons and while in Shanghai
they did not come to Police notice.

G. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

费利克斯·波拉克（Felix POLLAK），犹太裔德国公民，1896年12月23日出生于维也纳。他持有维也纳警方于1938年9月15日签发的第25606号护照，有效期一年，适用于前往法国、英国、美国、日本和中国旅行。在该护照中，他的职业被列为商业雇员。

看来他于1938年9月30日经西伯利亚离开维也纳前往远东。1938年10月18日，他与妻子一同乘坐“青岛丸”号轮船从大连抵达上海。

据他自己陈述，他是九江路150号303室维也纳裁缝公司（Vienna Tailoring Co.）的合伙人，该公司由另一位德国犹太人 J. Sinai 约两个月前创立，Sinai 近期刚从德国抵达上海。

目前他与妻子葆拉·波拉克（Paula Pollak，娘家姓 Kornmehl，1909年12月1日出生于维也纳）同住于德拉司德路（Route Delastre）2号。

当地德国总领事馆对这些人员没有不利了解，且他们在上海期间未引起警方注意。

G. 普罗科菲耶夫
警探长

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C Gascoigne J.S

David Solomonovich DVORJETZ, Russian Jew, born on
August 18, 1899 at Minsk, Russia. He is reported to have ar-
rived in Shanghai from Vladivostok in 1920. From 1921 to
1936 he was employed as a supervisor with the British Ame-
rican Tobacco Co., Ltd ( at present -Yee Tsoong Tobacco Co ).
Leaving this service owing to a reduction in staff, he took
over from one A.S. Kleinerman the enterprise known as the
"Little Chocolate Shop", 817 Avenue Joffre. Towards the end
of 1936 the business was reorganized and has since been known
as the "D.D.'s Night Club & Cafe Restaurant". The venture
proved to be fairly successful and at present, apart from
the main place at 815 Avenue Joffre, Mr. Dvorjetz operates
two branches ( D.D.'s Down Town Cafe Restaurant, 319 Szechuen
Road, and D.D.'s Cafe Restaurant, 870 Buboling Well Road ).
These establishments are known to be conducted in an orderly
manner and are well patronized by a respectable class of pat-
rons. Mr. Dvorjetz also owns a chocolate factory and bakery
at Pass. 833/2 Avenue Joffre.

On June 21, 1932 he married one Nina Dimitrievna
BELONOJKIN, Russian, born on 16-6-1907 at Harbin, reported to
be the daughter of a Soviet citizen who was formerly employ-
ed with the Chinese Eastern Railway. Rumours have it that
she possessed a small capital which was later utilised by her
husband for the development of his business. Early in 1938
the couple separated and it is reported that later during the
same year an agreement to this effect was concluded between
them at a local lawyer's office. Following the separation,
Mrs Dvorjetz has been conducting a ladies' dressmaking busi-
ness at her residence, 1202 Avenue Joffre, Apt. 77 ( Gascogne

大卫·所罗门诺维奇·德沃尔杰茨（David Solomonovich DVORJETZ），俄籍犹太人，1899年8月18日出生于俄罗斯明斯克。据报他于1920年从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海。1921年至1936年间，他受雇于英美烟草公司（British American Tobacco Co., Ltd，现为宜中烟草公司）担任监工。因裁员离开该职后，他从A.S. Kleinerman手中接管了位于霞飞路817号、名为“小巧克力店”（Little Chocolate Shop）的企业。1936年底，该企业重组，此后更名为“D.D.夜总会及咖啡餐厅”（D.D.'s Night Club & Cafe Restaurant）。这项经营相当成功，目前除了在霞飞路815号的主店外，德沃尔杰茨先生还经营两家分店（位于四川路319号的D.D.市中心咖啡餐厅，以及位于蒲石路870号的D.D.咖啡餐厅）。这些场所已知经营有序，顾客多为体面人士。德沃尔杰茨先生在霞飞路833/2号弄堂还拥有一家巧克力工厂和面包房。

        德沃尔杰茨在穆尔明路俄国侨民委员会及上海市政府警察局登记备案（1926年2月18日登记号00307）。在他的朋友中，有几个人曾因亲苏态度而受到高度怀疑。然而，德沃尔杰茨本人及其妻子在上海期间均未引起警方注意。

                                A. Prokopieff
                                特别调查员

DD's CAFE RESTAURANT.

SHANGHAI, 3rd June, 1938/

To the Secretary,
Department of the Interior,
CANBERRA, AUSTRALIA.

Dear Sirs,

Enclosed please find an application for
permit to enter Australia. In addition to this
application I would like to submit the following.

I left Russia in May 1920 having arrived
to Shanghai from Vladivostok. On my arrival in
Shanghai I was employed by Messrs. Eichenbaum
Tobacco Co. where I was working for eight months,
and left this job on account of the factory being
closed down. On June 3rd of 1921 I joined the
British American Tobacco Co., Ltd. (at present Yee
Tsoong Tobacco Co. Ltd.) and was there until the
1st of January 1936, which is certified by the
letter of one of the Directors of the above mentioned
firm.

On January 1st, 1936, with the money received
from Yee Tsoong Tobacco Co. Ltd., as a provident fund
I started a small Cafe under the name of Little
Chocolate Shop, which had a very good success.

Eight months later I transferred my business
to a much bigger place under the name of DD's Cafe,
Russian Restaurant, Bar and Russian Night Club and
for almost two years I had such a success in this place
so that at the present time I have my own Chocolate
Factory and Bakery and two large branches in Shanghai
under the name of DD's Cafe Restaurant.

As a result of the success of my business I
returned not only the capital which I had put in it,
but doubled same, and have a large business with the
good name, free of any indebtedness.

I am enclosing herewith a letter from the
Chartered Bank of India, Australia and China which
speaks for itself.

I, also, enclose a letter from the Chief of
the French Municipal Police in Shanghai from which you
will see that I have never been in court or prison.

From the enclosed letter, which will show you that
I am the partner of the newly established firm under the
name of the Silkwear Creations Co.

My intention to leave China is for the reason
of uncertainty in peace in the Far East since 1927, which
leads to the constant war every 5 years. I want to
settle down in Australia for good and will try my best to
be a good, honest and hard working citizen of Australia.

Enclosed herewith please find two photos of my
wife and myself.

Yours faithfully,

D.S. DVORJETZ.

副本。
DD'S 咖啡餐厅。

上海，1938年6月3日/

致：
内政部秘书，
澳大利亚，堪培拉。

尊敬的先生们：

随函附上进入澳大利亚的许可证申请。除该申请外，我还想提交以下材料。

我于1920年5月离开俄罗斯，从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海。抵沪后，我受雇于艾兴鲍姆烟草公司（Eichenbaum Tobacco Co.），工作了八个月，后因工厂关闭而离职。1921年6月3日，我加入英美烟草有限公司（现宜中烟草有限公司），并一直工作至1936年1月1日，此事可由上述公司的一位董事的证明信证实。

1936年1月1日，我用从宜中烟草有限公司获得的公积金创办了一家名为“小巧克力店”的小咖啡馆，经营状况非常好。

八个月后，我将业务转移到一个更大的场所，命名为DD'S咖啡馆、俄式餐厅、酒吧及俄式夜总会。在该场所经营的近两年时间里，我取得了巨大的成功，以至于目前我拥有自己的巧克力工厂和面包房，并在上海开设了两家大型分店，均名为DD'S咖啡餐厅。

由于业务成功，我不仅收回了投入的资本，还使其翻了一番，并且拥有良好的声誉，没有任何债务。

随函附上印度、澳大利亚和中国特许银行（Chartered Bank of India, Australia and China）的来信，其内容足以说明问题。

此外，我还附上了上海法租界警务处长的来信，从中您可以看出我从未上过法庭或进过监狱。

随附的信函还将向您表明，我是新成立的名为“丝绸时装创作公司”（Silkwear Creations Co.）的合伙人。

我离开中国的原因是自1927年以来远东地区和平局势的不确定性，导致每五年就发生一次战争。我想在澳大利亚永久定居，并将尽最大努力成为澳大利亚一名良好、诚实和勤劳的公民。

随函附上我和妻子的照片两张。

此致

D.S. DVORJETZ.

REPORT
Date January 30, 1939

Subject H. Schaefer, applicant for a certificate of good character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by [手写签名]

Hans SCHAEFER, German citizen of Jewish origin,
was born on December 4, 1913 at Berlin. He holds passport
No. II-2741/38 issued by the Berlin Police on 15-9-38, valid
for three months, according to which he is a merchant by oc-
cupation.

It appears that on 14-11-38 he left Berlin for
Italy and towards the end of the same month proceeded for
the Far East, arriving in Shanghai on December 20, 1938 in the
s.s. "Conte Biancamano". At present he resides at 1230 Ave-
nue Joffre, apt. 25.

According to his own statement, shortly prior to
his departure from Berlin he obtained from the Police a certi-
ficate of good conduct. This certificate was retained by the
German Consulate-General in Milan on 18-11-38 when he ap-
plied for and was granted prolongation of his passport for
another six months.

On January 19, 1939 when he applied for registration
at the local German Consulate-General his passport was endor-
sed to the effect that in conformity with the new regulations
concerning German citizens of Jewish origin the name "Israel"
had been added to his German name.

While in Shanghai he did not come to Police notice.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

[左侧手写批注：dbl 30/1]

D. C. (Special Branch).

据悉，他于1938年11月14日离开柏林前往意大利，并于同月底启程前往远东，于1938年12月20日乘坐“比安卡马诺伯爵号”轮船（s.s. "Conte Biancamano"）抵达上海。目前他居住在霞飞路1230号25室。

据其自述，在离开柏林前不久，他从警方获得了一份品行良好证明。1938年11月18日，当他向米兰德国总领事馆申请并获得护照延期六个月时，该证明被领馆留存。

1939年1月19日，当他向当地德国总领事馆申请登记时，他的护照被加注，注明根据关于德籍犹太人的新规定，其德国姓名中已添加“以色列”（Israel）一名。

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

Joseph Georg PREUSS, German citizen of Jewish ori-
gin, born on April 12, 1894 at Kattowitz, Silesia. He is re-
ported to have arrived in Shanghai from Germany on November 22,
1933 in the s.s. "Andre Lebon" travelling on passport
No. 165 - 216/32 issued by the Berlin Police on 2-8-32, valid
for five years. A graduate of the Medical Faculty of Univer-
sity of Munich ( 1921 ) he established himself here as a medi-
cal practitioner with the offices at 778 Bubbling Well Road,
which were in 1935 removed to 882 Bubbling Well Road, Flat 120
(Majestic Apartments), his present address. For a short pe-
riod in 1934 he was a member of the firm " New Shanghai Doc-
tors Association", after which he has been working independent-
ly. He is registered with the Shanghai Medical Board, Public
Health Department, S.M.C.

Upon the expiration of his passport he was issued
by the local German Consulate-General on 27-7-37 passport
No. 247 valid for one year, which was renewed for another year
on 29-1-39 by the same consulate. In conformity with the new
regulations concerning German citizens of Jewish origin his full
name now is Israel Joseph Georg PREUSS.

According to his own statement, he was married, but
was divorced in 1929.

He is in possession of a certificate issued by the
Berlin Police on 12-9-33, when he was about to leave that city
for the Far East, to the effect that there was nothing in police
records against him.

Nothing detrimental is known regarding him at the
local German Consulate-General and while in Shanghai he did not
come to Police notice.
D. C. ( Special Branch)

（左侧页边批注：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.)）

约瑟夫·格奥尔格·普鲁士（Joseph Georg PREUSS），德籍公民，犹太裔，1894年4月12日出生于西里西亚卡托维兹（Kattowitz）。据报其于1933年11月22日乘坐“安德烈·勒邦”号（Andre Lebon）轮船从德国抵达上海，持柏林警方于1932年8月2日签发的第165 - 216/32号护照，有效期五年。他毕业于慕尼黑大学医学院（1921年），随后在此行医，诊所初设于静安寺路778号，1935年迁至静安寺路882号美琪公寓120室，即其现住址。1934年间，他曾短暂加入“新上海医生协会”，此后一直独立执业。他在工部局公共卫生处上海医务委员会注册。

护照过期后，当地德国总领事馆于1937年7月27日向其签发第247号护照，有效期一年；该领事馆又于1939年1月29日为其续期一年。根据关于犹太裔德国公民的新规定，其全名现为伊斯雷尔·约瑟夫·格奥尔格·普鲁士（Israel Joseph Georg PREUSS）。

据其自述，他曾结婚，但于1929年离婚。

他持有柏林警方于1933年9月12日签发的一份证明，当时他正欲离开该市前往远东，证明其在警方档案中无不良记录。

当地德国总领事馆方面未掌握对其不利的信息，且其在上海期间未引起警方注意。
副警长（特务科）

（左侧页边批注：助理员致副警长（特务科））

G. 普罗科菲耶夫
特别调查员

Subject.... N.I. Ivanoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by. D. S. Pavloff.    Forwarded by....................

Nikolai Ivanovitch IVANOFF, Russian, was born on
July 27, 1895 at Pskov, Russia. He is reported to have
left Russia in 1923 and subsequently resided in Harbin
until March 1931 when he proceeded to Shanghai. In the
beginning of 1932 he obtained a position of an assistant
mechanic with Sanitas Mineral Water Co., 302 Route de
Zikawei. Upon leaving that concern in January 1934 he
worked casually until December 1936 when he established his
own business under the style "Amper" Radio and Electric
Shop, 85, Route Vallon. He liquidated this business in
December 1938.

Olga Pavlovna IVANOFF, nee Malevinskaya, wife of
the above, was born on October 12, 1897 at Perm, Russia.
She married the applicant in 1918 and has since been residing
together with him.

The applicant is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, 118/I Moulmein Road and with the Police Bureau
of the City Government of Shanghai. (Reg. Cert. No. 12036
issued on 10-3-37.)

While in Shanghai, he did not come to the notice
of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable nature.

尼古拉·伊万诺维奇·伊万诺夫（Nikolai Ivanovitch IVANOFF），俄国人，1895年7月27日出生于俄国普斯科夫。据报其于1923年离开俄国，随后居住在哈尔滨，直至1931年3月前往上海。1932年初，他在徐家汇路302号Sanitas矿泉水公司获得助理机械师职位。1934年1月离开该公司后，他打零工直至1936年12月，此时他在华伦路85号开设了自己的商行，名为“Amper”无线电电器行。他于1938年12月清算了该业务。

奥尔加·帕夫洛夫娜·伊万诺娃（Olga Pavlovna IVANOFF），娘家姓马列文斯卡娅（Malevinskaya），系上述申请人之妻，1897年10月12日出生于俄国彼尔姆。她于1918年与申请人结婚，此后一直与其共同居住。

申请人在莫尔尼姆路118/I号俄国侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局登记。（登记证号12036，签发于1937年3月10日。）

其在上海期间，未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

Subject Communication dated 14-2-39 from the British Consulate-General
concerning A.A. Selin.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. [Signature]

Alexey Alexeyevich SELIN, Russian, born on
February 17, 1902 at Blagoveschensk, Amur Province,
Siberia. He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on 6-2-39
in the s.s. "Hoten Maru", travelling on visa No. 41
issued by the Harbin Police on 1-2-39, good for a
single trip to Shanghai. He also holds Residential
Certificate No. 7533 issued by the same Police on
7-6-38, in which it is stated that he resided in that
city from 1919.

According to his own statement, Selin was
employed as a mechanic at the power station of Soungari
Flour Mills, Ltd., Harbin (reported to have been taken
over by Japanese interests in 1932) from 1919 to 1939.

He holds an affidavit issued in lieu of
passport by the British Consulate-General at Harbin on
12-9-38 on the authority of Landing Permit No. 23423
issued on 28-7-38 by the Department of the Interior,
Canberra, F.C.T. Commonwealth of Australia. The permit
is valid until 28-7-39.

His wife, Mrs. Anna Mihailovna Selin nee
Ermolin, born on 27-5-1908 at Harbin and their daughter
Eugenie born on 15-5-33 at the same city, are expected
to arrive here as soon as Mr. Selin's property in Harbin
has been liquidated, after which the family intend to
proceed to Australia.

Selin resides at 24 Astor Road.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police
records concerning these persons.

D.C.(Special Branch).
G. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

阿列克谢·阿列克谢耶维奇·谢林（Alexey Alexeyevich SELIN），俄国人，1902年2月17日出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔省布拉戈维申斯克。他于1939年2月6日乘坐“Hoten Maru”号轮船从哈尔滨抵达上海，持哈尔滨警方于1939年2月1日签发的第41号签证，仅限单次前往上海。他还持有同一警方于1938年6月7日签发的第7533号居住证，其中注明他自1919年起居住在该市。

据其自述，谢林自1919年至1939年受雇于哈尔滨松花江面粉有限公司发电站担任机械师（据报该厂于1932年被日本势力接管）。

他持有英国驻哈尔滨总领事馆于1938年9月12日签发的代替护照的宣誓书，依据是澳大利亚联邦首都领地堪培拉内政部于1938年7月28日签发的第23423号登陆许可证。该许可证有效期至1939年7月28日。

其妻安娜·米哈伊洛夫娜·谢林夫人（Mrs. Anna Mihailovna Selin），娘家姓埃尔莫林（Ermolin），1908年5月27日出生于哈尔滨；其女尤金妮（Eugenie），1933年5月15日出生于同一城市。预计待谢林在哈尔滨的财产清算完毕后，她们将尽快抵达此处，之后全家打算前往澳大利亚。

谢林居住在阿斯特路24号。

工部局警务处档案中关于这些人员没有任何记录。

副警长（特务科）。

Dimitry Nikolaevich PIKALOFF, Russian, born on
October 24, 1896 in Altai Region, Siberia. He is
reported to have left Russia for Sinkiang Province,
China, in 1920 together with the remnants of Ataman
Annenkoff's detachment of the "White" Russian army in
Siberia and later to have made his way to Tientsin,
arriving in that city some time in 1923. According to
his own statement, he was employed in a garage at
Tientsin as an apprentice mechanic until 1925, after
which he proceeded to Shanghai. Here he was employed as
a mechanic on steam launches of the Shanghai Ferries
& Tenders Company Ltd., from 13-10-25 to June, 1926,
after which he worked casually in the same capacity
for about one year. In October, 1927 he was engaged by
L.E. Gale Company, Hankow, to work as a mechanic in
their automobile repair shop in that city. When this
company was liquidated in 1936 and their Service Station
was taken over by Hankow branch of China Motors, he
continued his service with the new company until March,
1937. From that time he has been unemployed.

been residing at 396 Rue Bourgeat. He holds passport
No.466/419566 issued on 15-4-38 by the Commissioner of
Police, Hankow, valid for one year and good for
travelling to Hongkong via Canton. It would appear from
his own statement that shortly prior to his departure
from Hankow he applied through the local British

德米特里·尼古拉耶维奇·皮卡洛夫（Dimitry Nikolaevich PIKALOFF），俄国人，1896年10月24日出生于西伯利亚阿尔泰地区。据报其于1920年随西伯利亚“白”俄军队阿塔曼·安年科夫（Ataman Annenkoff）支队的残部离开俄国前往中国新疆省，后辗转至天津，于1923年某时抵达该市。据其自述，他在天津一家车行当学徒机械师直至1925年，随后前往上海。在此地，他于1925年10月13日至1926年6月期间受雇于上海轮渡及驳船有限公司（Shanghai Ferries & Tenders Company Ltd.）担任蒸汽艇机械师，此后以同等身份打零工约一年。1927年10月，他被汉口 L.E. Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. .................... Forwarded by. C. Crawford

Nikolai Petrovich HOLOFF, Russian, born
on December 8, 1911 at Tientsin. According to his own
statement, he attended the St. Louis College in Tien-
tsin for six years and for about nine years was employ-
ed with Tientsin branch of Mustard & Co., Ltd, as a sales
man, leaving the service in December, 1938 on account of
the closing down of the branch.

He arrived in Shanghai from Tientsin on De-
cember 28, 1938 aboard the s.s. "Yusang" and has since
been residing at 173 Seymour Road, Apt. S-2.

He holds passport No. 00142 issued on 2-7-38
by the Public Safety Bureau of Greater Tientsin, valid
for six months and good for travelling to Shanghai and
return to Tientsin.

It appears from his own statement that while
in Tientsin he made an unsuccessful application recently
for an immigration visa to Australia.

On 16-2-39 he married one Mrs Valentina Ale-
xeyevna DAGAEFF nee Onipkin, Russian, born 1909 at Lian-
chouli. She holds passport No. 2113 issued on 13-3-38
by the Public Safety Bureau, Tientsin, valid for one year
and good for travelling to Poland, Italy and Manchukuo.
It appears from this passport that she visited Europe in
1938. She arrived from Tientsin together with Mr. Hok-
loff, their last known address in that city being 205
I-Ping Building, Bromley Road, British Concession.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police re-
cords concerning these persons.

D. C. (Special Branch)

（左侧批注：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 27/2）

Nikolai Petrovich HOLOFF，俄国人，1911年12月8日出生于天津。据其自述，他在天津圣路易学院（St. Louis College）就读六年，并在芥末公司有限公司（Mustard & Co., Ltd）天津分行担任推销员约九年，因该分行于1938年12月停业而离职。

他于1938年12月28日乘坐“裕昌”轮（s.s. "Yusang"）从天津抵达上海，此后一直居住在西摩路173号 S-2 公寓。

他持有由天津特别市公署公安局于1938年7月2日签发的第00142号护照，有效期六个月，适用于前往上海及返回天津。

据其自述，他在天津期间最近曾申请澳大利亚移民签证，但未获成功。

1939年2月16日，他与 Valentina Alexeyevna DAGAEFF 女士（婚前姓 Onipkin）结婚。Dagaeff 女士为俄国人，1909年出生于连州里（Lianchouli）。她持有由天津公安局于1938年3月13日签发的第2113号护照，有效期一年，适用于前往波兰、意大利和满洲国。从该护照来看，她曾于1938年访问欧洲。她与 Hokloff 先生一同从天津抵达，他们在该市的最后已知地址为英租界勃罗姆利路（Bromley Road）怡平大楼205号。

工部局警务处档案中无关于此二人的记录。

D. C. （特务科）

（左侧批注：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 2/27）
（右下签名：A. Prokofiev 副督察）

Subject A. Studentzoff, applicant for a certificate of character.
Made by D.S. Pavloff    Forwarded by C. Gange

Alexander Petrovitch STUDENTZOFF, naturalized
Chinese citizen of Russian origin, was born on March 8,
1916 in Harbin, Manchuria. He left Harbin for Tientsin
in 1928 and in September of the same year entered the
Saint Louis College in that city. Graduating from same
in December 1933, he proceeded to Shanghai and here entered
the Aurora University, in which he studied until May 1937
when he left for Harbin. He returned to Shanghai in
December 1938 and at present resides at 66 Route de
Grouchy.

Mrs. Anastassia Ivanovna STUDENTZOFF, nee Soulyt-
cheff, mother of the above, also a naturalized Chinese
citizen of Russian origin, was born on November 10, 1889
in Tomsk Province, Siberia. According to her own
statement, she resided in Harbin since 1914, when her
late husband was formerly employed with the Chinese
Eastern Railway. She arrived in Shanghai from Harbin
in January 1939. Previously she made several trips
from Harbin to Tientsin and Shanghai in order to visit
her son. At present she intends to return to Harbin
for the purpose of liquidating some property she still
owns in that city.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning these persons.

（批：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 3/3）

D.C. (Special Branch)        D. S. Pavloff

Alexander Petrovitch STUDENTZOFF，归化中国公民，俄裔，1916年3月8日出生于满洲哈尔滨。他于1928年离开哈尔滨前往天津，同年9月进入该市的圣路易学院。1933年12月毕业后，他前往上海，进入震旦大学就读，直至1937年5月离开前往哈尔滨。他于1938年12月返回上海，目前居住在葛罗西路66号。

Anastassia Ivanovna STUDENTZOFF 女士（婚前姓 Soulytcheff），上述人员之母，亦为归化中国公民，俄裔，1889年11月10日出生于西伯利亚托木斯克省。据其自述，自1914年起她一直居住在哈尔滨，当时其已故丈夫受雇于中东铁路。她于1939年1月从哈尔滨抵达上海。此前，她曾多次从哈尔滨前往天津和上海探望其子。目前她打算返回哈尔滨，以清理她仍在那座城市拥有的一些财产。

Made by _D.S.I. Frolofiev_    Forwarded by _C. [签名]_

Eugene Avgustovich ELLERS, Russian claiming
Latvian origin, was born on December 10, 1902 at Fort
Arthur, Manchuria. He is reported to be the son of a
merchant family of the Maritime Province and to have
attended a school at Vladivostok until 1918, when he
first came to Shanghai. He obtained employment in the
Bake-Rite Bakery, 36 Nanking Road, and six months later
returned to Vladivostok, where, according to his own
statement, he was employed by the American Underwriters
Company until 1921 when he was transferred to the
Harbin branch of the same firm. He returned to Shanghai
in 1922, failed to secure employment and left as a
greaser in the s.s. "Sheer", a German ship destined for
Hamburg, in which city he joined the crew of a Soviet
ship bound for Odessa where he was paid off. He then
proceeded to Vladivostok to visit his parents.
According to him, on arrival in that city he was arrested
for no apparent reason and imprisoned. He escaped and
returned to Shanghai via Harbin in 1925. Later he went
to Macao and was employed in the Portuguese Police
Force there for a short period. Returning in Shanghai
in 1926, he was employed for about six months with the
Asiatic Petroleum Company and in 1927 was appointed head
porter and later manager of the Cecil McBain
Transportation Company, 43 Szechuen Road which firm he
later purchased, but was forced to close down in 1928
owing to business depression. He then joined the staff
of the General Transport Company, 9 Foochow Road, where

Eugene Avgustovich ELLERS，俄国人，自称拉脱维亚裔，1902年12月10日出生于满洲旅顺口（Fort Arthur）。据报他是滨海省一个商人家庭的儿子，曾在符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的一所学校就读，直至1918年首次来到上海。他在南京路36号的 Bake-Rite 面包店找到工作，六个月后返回符拉迪沃斯托克，据其自述，他在那里受雇于美国承保人公司（American Underwriters Company），直到1921年被调往该公司的哈尔滨分公司。他于1922年返回上海，未能找到工作，随后作为加油工登上驶往汉堡的德国船只“Sheer”轮，在该城市他加入了一艘驶往敖德萨的苏联船只的船员队伍并在那里结清工资。随后他前往符拉迪沃斯托克探望父母。据他说，抵达该市后，他无明显原因被捕并入狱。他逃脱后，经哈尔滨于1925年返回上海。后来他去了澳门，并在那里短暂受雇于葡萄牙警察部队。1926年回到上海后，他在亚细亚火油公司（Asiatic Petroleum Company）工作了约六个月，1927年被任命为 Cecil McBain 运输公司（位于四川路43号）的首席搬运工，后任经理，他后来收购了该公司，但因商业萧条被迫于1928年停业。随后他加入福州路9号的通用运输公司（General Transport Company）的员工队伍，在那里

transportation company at 32 Tracey Terrace, French
Concession. In 1932 - 1935 he was a partner in the

From the latter part of 1937 he has been conducting his
own transportation company with an office at 20 Canton
Road. At present he resides at 21 Route Doumer together
with his wife, Mrs. Valentina Grigorievna Ellers nee
Lehanoff, born 23/4/1905 at Irkutsk, Siberia. She is
reported to have been residing in Shanghai for the past
nine years and to have married Ellers in 1930.

Ellers was wanted in connection with a case of
fraud in 1931, but the complaint against him was with-
drawn by the complainants. In March, 1932 his
application for a firearms licence was refused by the
Shanghai Municipal Police, owing to an unfavourable
report on his character: he was said to be of a violent
temper and was suspected of associating with criminals.
However, the latter point was not substantiated and in
view of certain services rendered by him to the Municipal
Police and after a special consideration of the matter,
a paid licence was granted to him in December, 1932 with
a warning of its subsequent withdrawal, if found necessary.

In September, 1936 Ellers was alleged to have
swindled a certain local foreign resident of $30,000.
However, no official complaint was made against him in
connection with this matter.

Alexander Alexandrovich SCHUMANN，俄国人，1900年5月2日出生于克里米亚叶夫帕托里亚（Evpatoria）。据其自称，他于1922年经蒙古离开俄国前往中国，随后前往天津。1922年至1924年，他在该市受雇于皮草商 A.M. Liapunoff，1924年至1929年作为 Liapunoff 的代表居住在甘肃省各地。

他于1929年底某时抵达上海。在此他以佣金制推销员身份工作至1932年，当时他建立了目前的业务——LUXURY SHOP CO.（豪华商店公司），位于爱文义路1637号，据报他是该公司的唯一所有者。

上述人士之妻 Eulampia Alexandrovna Schumann（娘家姓 Liapunoff），1905年9月29日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省。据报她自1930年从满洲抵达上海后一直居住于此。

Schumann 夫妇已在慕尔鸣路俄罗斯难民委员会以及上海市政府警察局登记（登记号 15137）。

工部局警务处档案中关于这些人无任何记录。

A. Prokofiev

Michail Michailovitch IVANOFF , Russian , was born
on September 20 , 1904 at Brest-Litovsk , Russia. He is
reported to have left Vladivostok in 1922 together with
Admiral Stark's Flotilla and to have landed in the Philippi-
ne Islands in January 1923. Early in 1924 he arrived in
Shanghai from Manila and has since been residing in this
city. While in Shanghai he was employed as follows:-
From 7-2-27 to 9-6-27 , Russian Detachment of the S.V.C.
From May 1928 to July 1930 , as an assistant trainer with
the Shanghai Greyhound Club. From 6-8-30 to 18-8-30 as a
bodyguard of Mr. Zau Mau Tsah , 1614 Bubbling Well Road.
From 15-10-30 to 28-1-39 as an assistant supervisor with
Belting and Leather Products Association , 57 Peking Road.
The applicant is in possession of good references
from his former employers.
He is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
118/1 Moulmein Road.
While in Shanghai , he did not come to the notice of
the Municipal Police in connection with any activities of
an undesirable nature.

D. S.

Michail Michailovitch IVANOFF，俄国人，1904年9月20日出生于俄国布列斯特-立托夫斯克（Brest-Litovsk）。据报他于1922年随斯塔克海军上将（Admiral Stark）的舰队离开符拉迪沃斯托克，并于1923年1月在菲律宾群岛登陆。1924年初他从马尼拉抵达上海，此后一直居住在该市。在上海期间，他的受雇情况如下：
1927年2月7日至1927年6月9日，上海志愿队（S.V.C.）俄罗斯分队。
1928年5月至1930年7月，在上海跑狗场担任助理驯兽师。
1930年8月6日至1930年8月18日，担任静安寺路1614号 Zau Mau Tsah 先生的保镖。
1930年10月15日至1939年1月28日，在北京路57号皮带皮革制品协会担任助理主管。
申请人持有前雇主的良好推荐信。
他已在慕尔鸣路118/1号俄罗斯难民委员会登记。
在上海期间，他未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

D. S.
P.A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)
(2)

L. A. Pavloff
副督察

D. C. (特别科)。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Br. Station,
REPORT
File No. S. El No. 517
No. S. B. D.
Date March 13, 1939.

Subject. E.V. Sergueyeff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C Gaspard

Evgeny Vassilievich SERGUEYEFF, naturalized
Chinese citizen of Russian origin, is reported to
have arrived in Shanghai from Chefoo on October 20,
1938. He holds naturalization certificate No.9022
issued on June 1, 1925 by the Ministry of Interior
of the Republic of China in which it is stated that
at that time he was 45 years of age and a teacher by
occupation.

According to the applicant, his age was stated
erroneously in the passport. He was born on 1-11-1889
in Simbirsk Province, Russia, and is a graduate of the
Chemistry Department of the Technologic Institute of
Harkov (194). He left Russia for Manchuria in 1920
and until 1936 resided first at Bukhedu Station of the
Chinese Eastern Railway, where he was employed as a
teacher in the local railway school (1920 - 1925), and
later at Harbin where he was employed in one of the
technical departments of the Chinese Eastern Railway
administration. It was in order to keep his employment
with the Chinese Eastern Railway, after that concern
had been taken over by the U.S.S.R., that he became a
naturalized Chinese citizen. Shortly after the sale
of the Chinese Eastern Railway to the Japanese (1935)
he left the service and proceeded to Chefoo where he
claims to have conducted a small business until October,
1938, after which he left for Shanghai.

Here he resided at House 17, Passage 66, Route
Lorton, until 22.2.39 when he removed to House 18,
Passage 51, Route de Grouchy, his present address.

事由：E.V. Sergueyeff，品行证明书申请人。

由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）呈报，经卡帕德（C Gaspard）转送

叶夫根尼·瓦西里耶维奇·谢尔盖耶夫（Evgeny Vassilievich SERGUEYEFF），俄裔归化中国公民，据报于1938年10月20日从烟台抵达上海。他持有中华民国内政部于1925年6月1日签发的第9022号归化证书，其中载明其时年45岁，职业为教师。

据申请人称，其护照中年龄记载有误。他于1889年11月1日出生于俄罗斯辛比尔斯克省（Simbirsk Province），毕业于哈尔科夫理工学院（Technologic Institute of Harkov）化学系（194）。他于1920年离开俄罗斯前往满洲，直至1936年，先居住在中东铁路布赫杜站（Bukhedu Station），在当地铁路学校任教（1920 - 1925），后居住于哈尔滨，在中东铁路管理局的一个技术部门任职。为了在该机构被苏联接管后保留其中东铁路的职位，他成为了归化中国公民。在中东铁路出售给日本（1935年）后不久，他离职前往烟台，声称在那里经营小本生意直至1938年10月，随后前往上海。

在此期间，他居住在辣斐德路（Route Lorton）66弄17号，直至1939年2月22日搬至格罗希路（Route de Grouchy）51弄18号，即其现住址。

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

Sir:

Re: Herman Korczyn

Our client, Mr. Herman Korczyn, intends to take up a permanent residence in Australia and to this effect has communicated his application to the authorities in Canberra.

They have, in return, informed him that a landing permit will be issued only on the condition that he present "a certificate from a Police Officer that neither he nor any member of his family has ever been in prison or in a mental hospital."

Mr. Korczyn and his family resided in Shanghai from November 1929, until 2nd February 1938, as evidence of which please find enclosed his driver's license No. 132 "K" issued 24/12/30. and renewed each year until 1937. You may also refer to Messrs. Credit Foncier d'Extreme Orient from whom he rented his flat during that period.

Details regarding Mr. Korczyn and his family are as follows:

Herman Korczyn Born in Vienna 30 Nov. 1895, Mecn. Eng. B. Sc.
Marie Korczyn (his wife) Born in Odessa 22 Feb. 1901, House wife
Theodor Korczyn (their son) Born in Vienna 3 Nov. 1922, Student.

On 2nd Feb. 1938, Mr. Korczyn and family moved to Hongkong and they are there at present, but due to the shortness of their stay in that place, a certificate from the Hongkong Police will not cover a long period to satisfy the Authorities at Canberra.

事由：Herman Korczyn

我们的客户 Herman Korczyn 先生打算在澳大利亚永久居住，并就此向堪培拉当局提交了申请。

作为回复，他们告知他，只有在提交“一份由警官出具的证明，证明他及其任何家庭成员从未入狱或住进精神病院”的条件下，才会签发登陆许可证。

Korczyn 先生及其家人自1929年11月至1938年2月2日居住在上海，作为证据，谨此附上他于1930年12月24日签发的第132 "K" 号驾驶执照，该执照每年续期直至1937年。您也可以向东方汇理银行（Credit Foncier d'Extreme Orient）查询，他在该期间向其租赁公寓。

关于 Korczyn 先生及其家人的详情如下：

Herman Korczyn 1895年11月30日出生于维也纳，机械工程理学学士。
Marie Korczyn（其妻） 1901年2月22日出生于敖德萨，家庭主妇
Theodor Korczyn（其子） 1922年11月3日出生于维也纳，学生。

1938年2月2日，Korczyn 先生及家人移居香港，目前仍在那里，但由于他们在该地停留时间较短，香港警方出具的证明无法涵盖足够长的时间段以满足堪培拉当局的要求。

Hongkong, 6th. March 1939.

To the Commissioner of Police
Shanghai.

Sir:

I have the intention to take permanent residence in Australia
and have communicated to this effect with the Authorities in
Canberra.
Under date of 31st of January I received word from Canberra that
my application for a landing permit will be granted under the condi-
tion that I furnish the Authorities there with
a) a certificate from a Police officer that neither I nor
any member of my family have ever been in prison or in
a mental hospital
b) a certificate from a medical practitioner as to the mental
and physical health of my family.
The certificate under b) from a local doctor is acceptable to them.
But due to the fact that I am living in this Colony only for a very
short period, the certificate under a) which has to cover a longer
period of time is unsufficient.

I have been living in Shanghai since November 1929, and I left for
Hongkong on the 2nd of February 1938. As a prove I am enclosing here-
with my driving licence which I took out in December 1930 and which
has been regularly renewed until the end of 1937.
The licence is enclosed to my letter.
As a further prove I beg to refer you to Messrs. Credit Foncier
d'Extreme Orient from whom I rented my flats since 1930.

This letter will be handed over to you through the courtesy of Mr.
M. Wiener of Messrs. Rodger & Wiener, to whom I kindly refer you for
any expenses in connection with the certificate as mentionned under
a).

Please give this matter your preferred attention and accept in
anticipation my deepest appreciation.

Very truly yours.

H. Korczyn

先生：

我打算在澳大利亚永久居住，并就此与堪培拉当局进行了沟通。
我在1月31日收到堪培拉方面的通知，我的登陆许可证申请将在以下条件下获准：
a) 提供一份由警官出具的证明，证明我及我的任何家庭成员从未入狱或住进精神病院
b) 提供一份由执业医师出具的关于我家属身心健康的证明。
他们接受 b) 项由当地医生出具的证明。
但由于我在这个殖民地居住的时间非常短，a) 项需要涵盖较长时间段的证明则不足够。

我自1929年11月起居住在上海，并于1938年2月2日前往香港。作为证明，谨此附上我于1930年12月申领并定期续期至1937年底的驾驶执照。
执照附于信后。
作为进一步证明，恳请阁下向东方汇理银行查询，我自1930年起向其租赁公寓。

此信将由 Rodger & Wiener 律师事务所的 M. Wiener 先生代为转交，关于上述 a) 项提及的证明所产生的任何费用，敬请与他联系。

敬礼。

Subject A.V. Selischeff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by J.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford

Aifont Vassilievich SELISCHEFF, Russian, born on
April 15, 1884 in Ural Province, Russia. A mechanic and boiler-
maker by occupation he is reported to have arrived in Shanghai
from Vladivostok in December, 1920 and has since been residing in
this city. He worked at the saw mill of Bloch Manufacturing &
Lumber Co. for a few months and in 1922-1933 conducted his own
workshops, Wenming and Dalny Roads corner, after which he has
been usually working as a mechanic.

For the past four years he has been residing at
1835 Bubbling Well Road, together with his wife, Mrs A.P.Seli-
scheff nee Borodin, 54, and his son, Alexander A.Selischeff, 24,
who is employed in the service department of Reliance Motors,
755 Avenue Joffre.

One of his daughters named Tatiana married seve-
ral years ago Mr. R.H.Teer, British subject, but is now reported
to live separately from her husband. She was employed with Maison
Arcus for many years and following the liquidation of this firm
about four months ago opened her own business at 10 Central Road
( Maison Tania ). His other daughter is the wife of Mr. M.M. So-
lovieff of the Union Brewery, Ltd ( Advertising Department ).

The Selischeff family are registered with the Rus-
sian Emigrants' Committee, Bubbling Well Road, and with the Shanghai
City Government Police Bureau.

On 28-8-33 A.V. Selischeff was sentenced by the
1-st S.S.J. Court to 3 months imprisonment on a charge of assault,
the sentence being suspended for three years. ( C.A.O. No. F-2346 )

A. Prokofiev
J.S.I.

事由 A.V. Selischeff，品行证明书申请人。

由 J.S.I. Prokofiev 拟写。经 C. Crawford 转呈

艾方特·瓦西里耶维奇·谢利谢夫（Aifont Vassilievich SELISCHEFF），俄罗斯人，1884年4月15日出生于俄罗斯乌拉尔省。职业为机械师和锅炉工，据报于1920年12月从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海，此后一直居住在本市。他曾在布洛赫制造与木材公司（Bloch Manufacturing & Lumber Co.）的锯木厂工作数月，并于1922年至1933年间在文明路（Wenming Road）与达尔尼路（Dalny Road）转角经营自己的作坊，此后通常以机械师为业。

过去四年间，他一直与其妻子 A.P. 谢利谢夫夫人（娘家姓博罗金 Borodin），54岁，及其子亚历山大·A·谢利谢夫（Alexander A. Selischeff），24岁，共同居住在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）1835号。其子在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）755号信义汽车行（Reliance Motors）的服务部任职。

他的一个女儿塔季扬娜（Tatiana）几年前嫁给了英国臣民 R.H. Teer 先生，但据报目前与丈夫分居。她在阿库斯商行（Maison Arcus）工作多年，在该商号约四个月前清算后，她在中央路（Central Road）10号开设了自己的店铺（塔尼亚商行 Maison Tania）。他的另一个女儿是联合啤酒厂有限公司（Union Brewery, Ltd）广告部的 M.M. 索洛维耶夫（M.M. Solovieff）先生的妻子。

谢利谢夫一家已在静安寺路的俄罗斯侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局登记注册。

1933年8月28日，A.V. 谢利谢夫因殴打罪被上海第一特区地方法院判处监禁三个月，缓刑三年。（C.A.O. 编号 F-2346）

A. Prokofiev
J.S.I.

（左侧手写批注：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 18/3）

Subject Communication dated 11-3-39 from the British Consulate-General
concerning P. S. Epifanoff.

Made by J. J. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. [Signature]

Peter Borisovich EPIFANOFF, Russian, born on August 2,
1902 in Perm Province, Russia. According to his own statement,
he graduated from the Perm Railway Technical School in 1919,
after which he proceeded to Manchuria, where from 1921 to 1925 he
was employed at Shevchenko Bros. Timber Concession, Irekte Sta-
tion, Chinese Eastern Railway. He first arrived in Shanghai in
1925 and worked here as a fireman and locksmith on board the
I.C.B.M. Co. S.S. "Linan" for about three months, after which he
left for Harbin. Returning to Shanghai some time during the sum-
mer of 1927 he was employed here for short periods with the Bri-
tish American Tobacco Co., and Woodworth Co. (?), Maxwell Road,
and from 4-8-28 to 7-8-29 served in the Russian Regiment, S.V.C.
Leaving the latter service on his own accord he was engaged in
August, 1929 by the Shanghai Waterworks Co., Ltd, with which he is
still employed as a mechanic.

He resides at 1001/20 Yangtszepoo Road ( Shanghai
Waterworks Co. Staff Quarters) together with his wife, Mrs Fai-
na Pavlovna Epifanoff nee Teshin, born in 1909 at Harbin, and
their son Pavel, 4 years of age.

They are registered with the Russian Emigrants' Commit-
tee, Coulmein Road, and with the Shanghai City Government Police
Bureau ( Reg. No 17447 ).

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records con-
cerning these persons.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

（左侧批注：P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) 21/3）
D. C. ( Special Branch ).

由 J. J. Prokofiev 拟写。经 C. [签名] 转呈

彼得·鲍里索维奇·埃皮法诺夫（Peter Borisovich EPIFANOFF），俄罗斯人，1902年8月2日出生于俄罗斯彼尔姆省。据其自述，他于1919年毕业于彼尔姆铁路技术学校，随后前往满洲，1921年至1925年间在中东铁路伊列克特站（Irekte Station）的舍甫琴科兄弟木材特许开采区（Shevchenko Bros. Timber Concession）受雇。他于1925年首次抵达上海，在中英轮船公司（I.C.B.M. Co.）的“利南”号（S.S. "Linan"）轮船上担任司炉和锁匠约三个月，随后前往哈尔滨。1927年夏季某时返回上海后，他曾短期受雇于英美烟草公司（British American Tobacco Co.）以及麦克斯威尔路（Maxwell Road）的伍德沃斯公司（Woodworth Co. (?)），并于1928年8月4日至1929年8月7日期间在上海万国商团（S.V.C.）俄罗斯联队服役。自愿离职后，他于1929年8月受雇于上海自来水公司有限公司（Shanghai Waterworks Co., Ltd），至今仍担任机械师。

他居住在杨树浦路（Yangtszepoo Road）1001/20号（上海自来水公司职员宿舍），与其妻法伊娜·帕夫洛夫娜·埃皮法诺娃夫人（娘家姓 Teshin，1909年生于哈尔滨）及他们4岁的儿子帕维尔同住。

他们在科尔门路（Coulmein Road）的俄罗斯侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局（注册号 17447）登记注册。

工部局警务处档案中无关于这些人的记录。

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

（左侧批注：P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) 21/3）
D. C. （特别科）。

Subject. Communication dated 14-6-39 from the British Consulate-General
concerning O. Singer.

Made by J.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. S. I.

Otto Singer is reported to have arrived in Shang-
hai from Europe some time in 1935 and to have since been
residing in this city being engaged in commercial pursu-
its. In 1935 - 1936 he was connected with J.G.S. Horn,
manufacturers' representative, 12 The Bund, and since
1936 has been the acting manager of Foo Glanzmann, Mer-
chants, 168 Canton Road ( Head Office: Trieste, Italy).
According to Singer, he is of Jewish origin and
was born on May 29, 1904 at Parduvitz, former Austria. He
claims to be Rumanian subject. About three weeks ago he
applied for renewal of his passport no 162568 issued in
1937 by the Rumanian Legation at Tokyo. It appears that
he has certain reasons to believe that, owing to recent
political changes in Rumania, he may be deprived of Ru-
manian citizenship.
Singer does not belong to the local Rumanian Asso-
ciation and is not known to its president. At present he
resides at 34 Route de Soissezon, Apt. 4 - B.
There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning this person.

A. Prokofiev
J. S. I.

P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)
21/5.
D. C. ( Special Branch )

由 J.S.I. Prokofiev 拟写。经 C. Crawford. S. I. 转呈。

据报奥托·辛格（Otto Singer）于1935年某时从欧洲抵达上海，此后一直居住在本市，从事商业活动。1935年至1936年间，他与外滩12号的制造商代表 J.G.S. Horn 有关联，自1936年以来一直担任广东路168号 Foo Glanzmann 商行的代理经理（总部：意大利的里雅斯特）。据辛格称，他是犹太裔，1904年5月29日出生于前奥地利的帕尔杜维茨（Parduvitz）。他声称自己是罗马尼亚臣民。约三周前，他申请更新由罗马尼亚驻东京公使馆于1937年签发的第162568号护照。看来他有某些理由相信，由于罗马尼亚近期的政治变动，他可能会被剥夺罗马尼亚国籍。
辛格不属于当地罗马尼亚协会，该协会主席也不认识他。目前他居住在瑞士路（Route de Soissezon）34号，4-B室。
工部局警务处档案中无关于此人的记录。

A. Prokofiev
J. S. I.

Subject G.P. Kandalintseff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. [签名]

Georgy Pavlovich KANDALINTSEFF, Russian, born on August 5, 1905 at Samara, Russia. According to his own statement, he left Vladivostok for Japan in 1920 and after about six months stay in that country arrived in Shanghai together with his mother and sisters. In 1921 the family proceeded to Europe. The applicant resided in Poland from 1921 to 1925 and in Paris from 1925 to 1934. He returned to Shanghai on 1-6-34 in the s.s. "D'Artagnan" and has since been residing in this city.

From 1-10-34 to 1-4-35 he worked as a salesman on a commission basis for W.I. Zimmerman Co., 215 Szechuen Road, and from June, 1935 to October, 1936 was employed as secretary in the Council of United Russian Organization (SORO), 8 Avenue Dubail. Leaving this employment on his own accord, he conducted a translation office at 105 Bearn Apartments, Avenue Joffre, until April, 1937 when he was engaged by the Broadway Mansions as a watchman. He is still employed there as a night clerk.

From November, 1938 he has been residing at 218 Macgregor Road together with his wife, Mrs Evgenia Alexandrovna KANDALINTSEFF nee Fritzler, born 30-1-1908 at Saratov, Russia, whom he married in 1933. Mrs. KANDALINTSEFF is reported to have been residing in Hankow and Shanghai from 1921 to 1932 when she left for France. She returned to Shanghai on 12-3-34 aboard the s.s. "Felix Russel".

Mr. and Mrs. Kandalintseff are registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road, and with the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau (Reg. No. 20983). There is nothing in Municipal Police records concerning these persons.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.
D.C. (Special Branch)

（左侧手写批注及印章：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 23/3）

由 D.S.I. Prokofiev 拟写 经 C. [签名] 转呈

格奥尔基·帕夫洛维奇·坎达林采夫（Georgy Pavlovich KANDALINTSEFF），俄罗斯人，1905年8月5日出生于俄罗斯萨马拉。据其自述，他于1920年离开符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）前往日本，在该国停留约六个月后，与母亲和姐妹一同抵达上海。1921年，全家前往欧洲。申请人于1921年至1925年居住在波兰，1925年至1934年居住在巴黎。他于1934年6月1日乘坐“达达尼昂”号（s.s. "D'Artagnan"）轮船返回上海，此后一直居住在本市。

1934年10月1日至1935年4月1日，他在四川路215号的 W.I. Zimmerman 公司担任佣金制销售员，1935年6月至1936年10月，他在杜巴伊路（Avenue Dubail）8号的俄罗斯统一组织理事会（SORO）担任秘书。自愿离职后，他在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）贝恩公寓（Bearn Apartments）105号经营一家翻译社，直到1937年4月受雇于百老汇大厦（Broadway Mansions）担任看守。他目前仍在那里担任夜班职员。

自1938年11月起，他一直与妻子叶夫根尼娅·亚历山德罗芙娜·坎达林采娃夫人（娘家姓 Fritzler，1908年1月30日出生于俄罗斯萨拉托夫，两人于1933年结婚）居住在麦格雷戈路（Macgregor Road）218号。据报坎达林采娃夫人于1921年至1932年间居住在汉口和上海，随后前往法国。她于1934年3月12日乘坐“费利克斯·拉塞尔”号（s.s. "Felix Russel"）轮船返回上海。

坎达林采夫夫妇已在莫尔门路（Moulmein Road）的俄罗斯侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局（注册号 20983）登记注册。工部局警务处档案中无关于这些人的记录。

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.
D.C.（特别科）

Subject N.D. Dimoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.J.I. Frolov. Forwarded by C. Gaspar

Nikita Dimitrievich DIKOFF, Russian, born on
April 16,1904 in Amur Province, Siberia. According to his
own statement, he left Russia for Manchuria in 1922 and
for the following three years resided in Harbin where he
finished a middle school ( 1924 ) and also attended a
school attached to the Sungari-Mongolian Mission of Se-
venth-Day Adventists from 10-12-23 to 25-5-25. From 1925
to 1928 he was employed as a bible worker by the Sungari-
Mongolian Mission in Hailar and Mongolia . In 1928-1929
he conducted a book-binder's shop in Harbin and from 1929
to 1934 worked as a mechanic for local representative of
Singer Sewing Machines.

He arrived in Shanghai from Tsingtao sometime
towards the end of 1934. Here he was employed as a sales-
man in the Sirius Store, 715 Avenue Joffre, for about 6
months, after which he worked independently selling vari-
ous goods on a commission basis and repairing sewing ma-
chines until June, 1936 when he opened a haberdashery and
toy store at 255-A Avenue du Roi Albert. Until 1938 he
often visited Tsingtao in connection with his work.

Mrs Vera F. Dimoff nee Belous, born 10-11-1909
in Manchuria, arrived in Shanghai together with her hus-
band and resides at the above address. They have one son
named Gedeon, aged 10 years.

Mr. and Mrs Dimoff are registered with the Rus-
sian Emigrants' Committee, Route de Zikawei, and with the Ci-
ty Government Police Bureau ( Reg. No. 402 ). On March 22,
1939 they were issued by the French Police certificates of

Nikita Dimitrievich DIKOFF，俄罗斯人，1904年4月16日出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔省。据其自述，他于1922年离开俄罗斯前往满洲，随后三年居住在哈尔滨，期间完成中学学业（1924年），并于1923年12月10日至1925年5月25日就读于基督复临安息日会松花江-蒙古传教团附属学校。1925年至1928年，他在海拉尔和蒙古受雇于基督复临安息日会松花江-蒙古传教团，担任圣经工作者。1928-1929年，他在哈尔滨经营一家装订店，1929年至1934年，他为胜家缝纫机（Singer Sewing Machines）的当地代表处担任技工。

他于1934年底某时从青岛抵达上海。在此之后，他在霞飞路715号天狼星商店（Sirius Store）担任售货员约6个月，此后独立从事佣金制商品销售及缝纫机修理工作，直至1936年6月在阿尔贝王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）255-A号开设一家服饰杂货及玩具店。直到1938年，他因工作关系经常前往青岛。

Vera F. Dimoff 夫人，婚前姓 Belous，1909年11月10日出生于满洲，与丈夫一同抵达上海，现居上述地址。他们育有一子，名为 Gedeon，现年10岁。

Dimoff 夫妇已在霞飞路俄罗斯侨民委员会以及市政府警察局登记（登记号 402）。1939年3月22日，法国警察向他们签发了品行

Subject A.I. Lvoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by C. Guintoli

Alexis Ivanovich LVOFF, Russian, born on
August 1, 1899 at St.Petersburg, Russia. According to his
own statement, he served in the Imperial Russian Army
from 1916 to 1918 and later in the "White" Army in Sibe-
ria until 1920 when he left for Manchuria. For the follow-
ing 16 years he resided in Harbin, his last employment in
that city being with the Chinese Eastern Railway ( 1935 -
1936). In June, 1936 he arrived in Shanghai. Here he work-
ed for about one year as an attendant in the Mental Ward
of the Russian Orthodox Confraternity and in November,
1937 joined the Russian Volunteer Detachment of the French
Police. From July, 1938 he was transferred to his present
position of watchman in the Koukaza Park, French Conces-
sion.

Lvoff is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, Moulmein Road, and with the Police Bureau of
Shanghai City Government ( Reg. No 18290 ) . He is a mem-
ber of the Union of Ex-Service men of Ataman Semenoff's
Special Detachment in Manchuria (OMO).

While in Shanghai he did not come to the no-
tice of the Municipal Police in connection with any acti-
vities of an undesirable character.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

（批：P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) 3/5.）

D. C. ( Special Branch )

Alexis Ivanovich LVOFF，俄罗斯人，1899年8月1日出生于俄罗斯圣彼得堡。据其自述，他于1916年至1918年在俄罗斯帝国军队服役，随后在西伯利亚的“白军”中服役，直至1920年离开前往满洲。随后的16年里，他居住在哈尔滨，在该市的最后一份工作是任职于中东铁路（1935-1936年）。1936年6月，他抵达上海。在此之后，他在俄罗斯东正教兄弟会的精神病房担任护理员约一年，并于1937年11月加入法国警察俄罗斯志愿队。1938年7月，他被调任至现职，即法租界古卡萨公园（Koukaza Park）的看守。

Lvoff 已在慕尔鸣路俄罗斯侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局登记（登记号 18290）。他是谢苗诺夫阿塔曼满洲特别支队退伍军人联盟（OMO）的成员。

在上海期间，他未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

（批注：P. A. 转 D. C. (特别科) 3/5。）

Subject. A.A. Bocevitch, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.S.

Antony Antonievich BOCEVITCH, Russian, born on January 16, 1911 at Nikolsk-Ussuryisk, Maritime Province, Russia. Former student of the Habarovsk Military Cadets School, he is reported to have left Vladivostok for Genzan some time towards the end of 1922 together with the school and to have later proceeded to Harbin to join his mother. Until 1928 he attended a local school, after which he worked as an apprentice motor car mechanic for a period.

In May, 1930 he arrived in Shanghai. Here he worked casually as a supervisor etc. until 15-1-31 when he joined the Russian Regiment, S.V.C. Leaving the service on his own accord on 14-4-31 he was employed as a clerk in the Loan Department of the International Savings Society, 7 Avenue Edward VII from 29-4-31 to 28-2-37 when he was discharged owing to a reduction in staff. During the following two years he worked as an overseer and general outdoor assistant for various local firms including the Henningsen Produce Co., ( about 5 months ), Shanghai Special Transport Co., Sassoon House ( 4 months ), Savoy Apartments, 133 Route de Say Zoong ( 7 months ) and N.G. Gladkoff, Contractor ( two months ). At present he is without any regular employment.

In 1934 he married one Miss V.A. Romani. The couple were divorced in 1938.

Bocevitch is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, and with the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau ( Reg. 12788 ). At present he resides at 1252/11 Rue Lafayette together with his mother and elder brother, Mr. V. Bocevitch, an employee of

由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由克劳福德（C. Crawford）副督察转呈。

安东尼·安东涅维奇·博采维奇（Antony Antonievich BOCEVITCH），俄国人，1911年1月16日出生于俄罗斯滨海省乌苏里斯克（Nikolsk-Ussuryisk）。据报他曾是哈巴罗夫斯克军校学员学校的学生，于1922年底左右随该校离开符拉迪沃斯托克前往元山（Genzan），随后前往哈尔滨与其母团聚。直至1928年，他在当地一所学校就读，此后曾做过一段时期的汽车机械学徒工。

1930年5月，他抵达上海。在此期间，他从事监工等临时性工作，直至1931年1月15日加入上海万国商团俄国队（Russian Regiment, S.V.C.）。1931年4月14日，他自愿离职，随后于1931年4月29日至1937年2月28日期间，受雇于爱多亚路7号国际储蓄会贷款部担任职员，后因裁员被解雇。在接下来的两年里，他为多家本地商行担任监工及一般外勤助理，包括亨宁森农产品公司（Henningsen Produce Co.，约5个月）、上海特种运输公司（Shanghai Special Transport Co.）、沙逊大厦（Sassoon House，4个月）、赛仲路133号萨伏伊公寓（Savoy Apartments，7个月）以及承包商N.G. Gladkoff（两个月）。目前他没有固定职业。

1934年，他与V.A. Romani小姐结婚。两人于1938年离婚。

博采维奇已在莫尔缅路118/1号的俄国侨民委员会登记，并在上海市政府警察局登记（登记号12788）。目前，他与母亲及兄长V. Bocevitch先生同住于拉斐德路1252/11号，其兄任职于

Ilya Alexeyevich GRIDNEFF, Russian, born on
July 24, 1887 at Vladikavkaz, Caucasus, Russia. According to
his own statement, he left Russia for Manchuria in 1920
and until 1937 resided in Harbin, during which period he
was employed with the Chinese Eastern Railway as an office
clerk ( 1921-1922 ) and in the Revenue Department of the
Harbin Municipal Administration as a bookkeeper ( 1923 -
1937 ). From 1-6-37 to 22-4-38 he resided at Tsingtao
where he was employed as a manager in the Pacific Hotel.
He arrived in Shanghai from Tsingtao on 23-4-38 in the
S.S. "Dairen Maru" travelling on passport No 4390 issued
on 20-4-38 by the Peace Maintenance Association, Tsingtao.
On August 1, 1938 he obtained his present employ-
ment as a ticket inspector at the Canidrome, 439 Avenue du
Roi Albert. Apart from this he works casually as a book-
keeper.

Mrs Valeria Filipovna Gridneff nee Kostromitin,
wife of the above, was born on 2-4-1897 in Kovno Province,
Russia. She is a dentist by occupation and arrived in Shang-
hai together with her husband. They have one son named
Igor, born 9-2-1930 at Harbin. They reside at 368 Rue Bour-
geat, apt. 7.

Mr. and Mrs Gridneff are not registered with the
Russian Emigrants' Committee or with the Council of United
Russian Organization (SORO). On 4-3-39 they were issued by
the French Police certificates of good character ( Nos 222
and 221, respectively ).

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning these persons.
A. Prokofiev

伊利亚·阿列克谢耶维奇·格里德涅夫（Ilya Alexeyevich GRIDNEFF），俄国人，1887年7月24日出生于俄罗斯高加索地区的弗拉季卡夫卡兹（Vladikavkaz）。据其自述，他于1920年离开俄罗斯前往满洲，直至1937年居住在哈尔滨，期间曾在中东铁路担任办公室职员（1921-1922），并在哈尔滨市政管理局税务局担任簿记员（1923-1937）。1937年6月1日至1938年4月22日，他居住在青岛，在太平洋饭店担任经理。1938年4月23日，他乘坐“大连丸”号轮船（S.S. "Dairen Maru"）从青岛抵达上海，持青岛治安维持会于1938年4月20日签发的第4390号护照旅行。1938年8月1日，他获得现任职位，在阿尔伯特王路439号跑狗场（Canidrome）担任检票员。除此之外，他还从事临时的簿记工作。

上述人之妻瓦莱里娅·菲利波芙娜·格里德涅娃（Mrs Valeria Filipovna Gridneff），娘家姓科斯特罗米京（Kostromitin），1897年4月2日出生于俄罗斯科夫诺省（Kovno Province）。她的职业是牙医，与丈夫一同抵达上海。他们育有一子，名伊戈尔（Igor），1930年2月9日出生于哈尔滨。他们居住在布尔热路368号7室。

格里德涅夫夫妇未在俄国侨民委员会或全俄侨民联合会（SORO）登记。1939年3月4日，法国警察向他们签发了品行良好证明书（编号分别为222和221）。

工部局警务处档案中无关于这些人的记录。

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Crawford

Nikolai Georgievich KRISUK, Russian, born on
August 9, 1917 in Volyn Province, Russia. According to
his own statement, he escaped from the U.S.S.R. to
Manchuria in 1930 together with his parents and for the
following four years resided in Harbin, during which
period he worked first as an apprentice and later as a
mechanic in various local garages, including Jaques
Kremantaski's automobile and general repair workshops.
He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin some time
during the end of 1934, and soon afterwards was engaged
by Bills Motors, Avenue Foch, as a motor mechanic. In
May, 1935 he was discharged owing to a reduction in
staff, following which he was without regular employment
until the autumn of 1936 when he was engaged as an
apprentice by the Victor's Beauty Parlour, North Soochow
Road. From April, 1937 he has been working as a barber
in various local barber shops including Basil's Beauty
Parlour, 833/9 Avenue Joffre, Vienna Beauty Parlour,
Route des Soeurs, and Nick's Beauty Parlour, 217 Route
des Soeurs. In August 1938 he became the sole owner of
the latter enterprise.

Krisuk resides at 508 Route Vallon together with
his parents, Mr. and Mrs. G.I. Krisuk, aged 58 and 46
years respectively. He is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road, and with the
Shanghai City Government Police Bureau (Reg. No.3573).

尼古拉·格奥尔基耶维奇·克里苏克（Nikolai Georgievich KRISUK），俄国人，1917年8月9日出生于俄罗斯沃伦省（Volyn Province）。据其自述，他于1930年与父母一起从苏联逃往满洲，并在随后的四年里居住在哈尔滨，期间先在当地的多家汽车修理厂（包括Jacques Kremantaski的汽车及综合修理车间）做学徒，后担任机械师。

他于1934年底某时从哈尔滨抵达上海，不久后被霞飞路的比尔斯汽车行（Bills Motors）聘为汽车机械师。1935年5月，因裁员被解雇，此后直到1936年秋之前一直无固定职业，当时他被北苏州路的维克多美容厅（Victor's Beauty Parlour）聘为学徒。自1937年4月起，他在当地多家理发店担任理发师，包括乔赛普路833/9号的巴西尔美容厅（Basil's Beauty Parlour）、修女路的维也纳美容厅（Vienna Beauty Parlour）以及修女路217号的尼克美容厅（Nick's Beauty Parlour）。1938年8月，他成为后一家企业的唯一所有者。

克里苏克与父母G.I. Krisuk先生和夫人（年龄分别为58岁和46岁）同住于瓦隆路508号。他已在莫尔缅路的俄国侨民委员会和上海市政府警察局登记（登记号3573）。

Alexey Nikolaevich Pisareff, Russian, born on
March 17, 1913 at Nikolisk-Ussuryisk, Maritime Province,
Russia. According to his own statement, he left Russia
for Manchuria in November, 1920 and for the following 12
years resided together with his parents at Hundaohedzi
Station, Chinese Eastern Railway. From 1932 to 1934 he re-
sided at Harbin where he claims to have worked in various
local garages as an apprentice mechanic and to have finish-
ed a school for drivers. In 1934 - 1936 he was employed
as an overseer by China Moto Tractor Company, Hundaohedzi Sta-
tion, C.E.R., for about two years and as a mechanic at a
Japanese military aerodrome in Eastern Manchuria for about
6 months.

He arrived in Shanghai on 23-1-39 aboard the
S.S. "Dairen Maru" and on 6-2-39 joined the Russian Vo-
lunteer Detachment of the French Police, in which he is
still serving.

His mother, Mrs M.F. Sergeyeff, age 55, resides
at 120 Route Vallon ( Russian Baptist Church ) and his
brothers, I.M. Pisareff and S.M. Pisareff have been serv-
ing in the Russian Regiment, S.V.C., for 5 and 2 years, res-
pectively.

The applicant is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, Loumein Road, on the strength of
passport No 67 issued by the Harbin Police on 6-1-39.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police re-
cords concerning this person.

阿列克谢·尼古拉耶维奇·皮萨列夫（Alexey Nikolaevich Pisareff），俄国人，1913年3月17日出生于俄罗斯滨海省乌苏里斯克（Nikolisk-Ussuryisk）。据其自述，他于1920年11月离开俄罗斯前往满洲，并在随后的12年里与父母一同居住在中东铁路浑道河子站（Hundaohedzi Station）。1932年至1934年，他居住在哈尔滨，声称在当地多家车库担任见习机械师，并完成了驾驶学校的学习。1934年至1936年，他在中东铁路浑道河子站的中国摩托拖拉机公司（China Moto Tractor Company）担任监工约两年，并在满洲东部的一处日本军用机场担任机械师约6个月。

他于1939年1月23日乘坐“大连丸”号轮船（S.S. "Dairen Maru"）抵达上海，并于1939年2月6日加入法国警察局的俄国志愿分队，目前仍在该队服役。

其母 M.F. 谢尔盖耶夫（Sergeyeff）夫人，55岁，居住在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）120号（俄国浸信会教堂）；其兄弟 I.M. 皮萨列夫和 S.M. 皮萨列夫分别在俄国兵团（Russian Regiment, S.V.C.）服役5年和2年。

申请人凭哈尔滨警察局于1939年1月6日签发的第67号护照，在穆伦路（Loumein Road）的俄国侨民委员会登记。

John Arthur MOON was born at Southport,

moneyed family, he has an independent income and does
not need to work for a living.

上述人士之妻瓦莱丽·鲁宾（Valerie RUBIN）夫人，1892年8月31日出生于前奥地利布鲁恩（Bruenn）。她于1938年12月31日乘坐“孔特·罗索”号轮船（S.S. "Conte Rosso"）经特里雅斯特从维也纳抵达上海，所持护照为维也纳警察局于1938年9月28日以寡妇瓦莱丽·鲁宾多夫（RUBINDORF）夫人名义签发的第26707号护照。1939年1月5日，她与乘坐同一艘船抵达上海的菲比斯·鲁宾先生结婚。（结婚证第277/118号，由上海切伊尔·莫伊谢犹太会堂签发）。

他们在犹太救济委员会（登记卡号分别为34和35）及德国总领事馆登记。目前居住在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）335号。

Subject H.A. Mihailoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev    Forwarded by C. Crawford E.J.

Herman Alexandrovich MIHAILOFF, Russian, was born
on April 1, 1912 at Harbin. Son of an officer of the Russian
Army he is reported to have attended a school in Harbin un-
til 1928, after which he proceeded to Shanghai. In Septem-
ber of the same year he left this city as a mess room boy
on a German boat destined for Europe. In this and similar
capacities he worked on various vessels until May, 1932 when
he was engaged in Antwerp as a Junior Assistant of Deck on
a boat of Moller & Co. and returned to Shanghai. He is still
employed with this company and at present is Chief Officer
of the s.s. "Henriette Moller".

The applicant is registered with the Russian Emi-
grants' Committee, Moulmein Road, and at present resides at
302 Route Cardinal Mercier. He holds Certificate of Iden-
tity issued on 21-12-37 by Representative in China of the
Nansen International Office for Refugees on the strength of
passport No. 13848 issued by the Shanghai City Government
Police Bureau on 29-5-36.

On 13-5-1938 while on a trip to Australia he mar-
ried one Miss Audrey May BEST, British subject, born on
28-1-21 at Launceston, Tasmania. She arrived in Shanghai from
Australia in October, 1938 together with her husband and has
since been employed in the Stationery Department, Miller &
Co., 30 Foochow Road.

While in Shanghai the applicant did not come to the
notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any acti-
vities of an undesirable nature.

D.C. ( Special Branch).

赫尔曼·亚历山德罗维奇·米哈伊洛夫（Herman Alexandrovich MIHAILOFF），俄国人，1912年4月1日出生于哈尔滨。作为俄国军官之子，据报道他在哈尔滨上学直至1928年，随后前往上海。同年9月，他作为餐室侍者离开本市，登上一艘驶往欧洲的德国船只。在此类职位上，他在多艘船只上工作，直到1932年5月在安特卫普受雇于马勒公司的一艘船上担任初级甲板助理，并返回上海。他目前仍受雇于该公司，现任“亨丽埃特·马勒”号轮船（s.s. "Henriette Moller"）的大副。

申请人在穆伦路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会登记，目前居住在梅尼耶主教路（Route Cardinal Mercier）302号。他持有南森国际难民办公室驻华代表于1937年12月21日签发的身份证明书，依据的是上海市政府警察局于1936年5月29日签发的第13848号护照。

1938年5月13日，他在前往澳大利亚的途中与英国臣民奥黛丽·梅·贝斯特（Audrey May BEST）小姐结婚，后者于1921年1月28日出生于塔斯马尼亚朗塞斯顿（Launceston）。她于1938年10月与丈夫一同从澳大利亚抵达上海，此后一直在福州路30号米勒公司（Miller & Co.）的文具部工作。

在上海期间，申请人未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

Dear Sir,

I am sorry to bother you with this letter but I

proceed to Australia to join my wife there, and would like
