Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. C. Gaspari, S.I.

Nikolai Pavlovich FROLOFF, Russian, born on November 28, 1892 at Urjum, Viatka Province, Russia. Former junior war time officer in the "White" army in Siberia, he is reported to have arrived in Manchuria from Russia in 1920 together with the remnants of the army. He claims to have graduated from the Institute for Oriental Sciences at Vladivostok in 1916 and from the Philologic Faculty at the same city in 1919. According to his own statement, he resided at Pogranichnaya Station, Chinese Eastern Railway, from May, 1920 to October, 1925 being employed as a teacher in the local technical school of the C.E.R., and from from October, 1925 to April, 1935 - at Harbin where he was employed in the same capacity in a middle school. He became a Soviet citizen in 1923, but renounced his allegiance to the Soviet government in 1934 and took out emigrants' papers .

Froloff arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in April, 1935. Here he was employed as a teacher in the First Russian School, Yulin Road, from 1935 to June, 1937, after which he is reported to have been giving private lessons.

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee, Moulmein Road, and with the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau ( Reg. No. 15892 ). On 19-4-39 he obtained from the French Police a certificate of good character ( No. 208 ). At present he resides at Passage 697 Avenue Joffre, House 7, Room 7.

Froloff is a divorcee and has one daughter and one son named Julia ( b.1918) and Victor (b.1921), respecti-

尼古拉·巴甫洛维奇·弗罗洛夫（Nikolai Pavlovich FROLOFF），俄罗斯人，1892年11月28日出生于俄罗斯维亚特卡省（Viatka Province）乌尔茹姆（Urzum）。他曾是西伯利亚“白军”的一名初级战时军官，据报于1920年随残部从俄罗斯抵达满洲。他声称于1916年毕业于符拉迪沃斯托克的东方学院，并于1919年毕业于该市的语文系。据其自述，1920年5月至1925年10月期间，他居住在中东铁路的边境站（Pogranichnaya Station），受雇于中东铁路当地技术学校担任教师；1925年10月至1935年4月期间，他在哈尔滨一所中学担任同等职务。他于1923年成为苏联公民，但于1934年放弃对苏联政府的效忠，并办理了侨民证件。

弗罗洛夫于1935年4月从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此之后，他于1935年至1937年6月期间在榆林路的第一俄国人学校担任教师，此后据报从事私人授课。

他已在莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局登记（登记号 15892）。1939年4月19日，他从法租界警务处获得了一份品行良好证明书（编号 208）。目前他居住在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）697弄7号7室。

弗罗洛夫已离婚，育有一女一子，分别名为朱莉娅（Julia，生于1918年）和维克多（Victor，生于1921年），

Horst Manfred WETZELL, German (Aryan),
born at Morchingen, Germany on August 29, 1900
arrived in Shanghai from Europe in November, 1932.
His father, General WETZELL, was formerly
(1930) Military Adviser to the Chinese Nationalist
Government.
Applicant is a respected member of the
local German community who has never been charged
with any criminal or political offence during his
residence in Shanghai, neither has he been committed
to any institution for mental incompetency.
He is at present an employee of Messrs.
Carlowitz & Co. and is leaving Shanghai on May 2
for a business tour of Europe, the United States
and South America.

Ga. Piers.
D. S.
D.C. (Special Branch)

and to have since been residing in this city. Here he was
employed as a driver, mechanic, general machine and motor
engineer with various firms including the Credit Foncier
d'Extreme Orient, Brick Works Department ( 1926-1928 ),
Purity Water Distilling Co. ( for several years with in-
tervals ), Hartzenbusch Motor Co. ( 1929-1930 ). From
1930 to 1933 he is reported to have been conducting his
own business - the "Russian Motor Repairs Shop" and from
February, 1933 has been employed with Texas Co. ( China), Ltd.
as a service station attendant.

He is registered with the Russian emigrants
Committee, Moulmein Road, and with the Shanghai City Govern-
ment Police Bureau ( Reg. No. 1463 ). At present he resides
at 363 Avenue du Roi Albert.

On 21-4-39 he obtained from the French Police
a certificate of good character ( No. 232 ).

There is nothing in the Municipal Police re-
cords concerning this individual.

According to his own statement, he intends to
proceed to Australia on invitation of Mr. E.A. Lake, who
retired from the service in the Public Works Department of
the Shanghai Municipal Council early in 1938 and at present
resides at 38 Redefern Street, North Perth, Perth, Western
Australia.

帕维尔·济诺维耶维奇·沃多沃佐夫（Pavel Zinovievich VODOVOZOFF），俄罗斯人，1903年2月16日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克。据报他于1923年某时从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海，并自此居住于本市。在此期间，他曾在多家公司受雇担任司机、机械师、通用机器及汽车工程师，包括东方汇理银行（Credit Foncier d'Extreme Orient）、砖厂部（1926-1928）、纯净蒸馏水公司（Purity Water Distilling Co.，断续工作数年）、哈岑布施汽车公司（Hartzenbusch Motor Co.，1929-1930）。据报1930年至1933年间，他经营自己的生意——“俄国汽车修理店”，自1933年2月起，受雇于德士古公司（中国）有限公司（Texas Co. (China), Ltd.）担任加油站服务员。

他已在莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局登记（登记号 1463）。目前他居住在阿尔伯特王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）363号。

1939年4月21日，他从法租界警务处获得了一份品行良好证明书（编号 232）。

工部局警务处档案中关于此人没有任何记录。

据其自述，他打算应 E.A. Lake 先生的邀请前往澳大利亚。Lake 先生于1938年初从上海公共租界工部局工务处退休，目前居住在澳大利亚西澳珀斯北珀斯雷德芬街（Redefern Street, North Perth, Perth, Western Australia）38号。

（批注：助理致 特务科副总巡官 4月28日）

A. Prokofiev
副督察

特务科副总巡官。

Re: Vodovosoff, Paul Request for certification of no criminal

Sir:

In preparation for immigration to Australia, I have secured
from the French Concession Police a certification that I have
no criminal record in the French Concession. This certification
has been placed upon my Certificate as a Resident, French
Concession,No.8726. Application is hereby respectfully made
for a similar certification by the Shanghai Municipal Police.

The following details are given for your information,

I arrived in Shanghai in 1922 and obtained a job with
the Purity Water Distilling Company as engineer. Mr. B.
B. McLean was the owner and operator of this company.
When the business was put up for sale, I obtained a job
with the Hartzenbusch Motor Company in 1929. In 1933 I
obtained a job with the Texas Co.,Ld. as a Texaco
Filling Station operator, and I am still employed by
that company, and operate their Texaco Filling Station
at 786 Avenue Joffre.

The certification requested is required for submission to
the Minister of the Interior for Australia, in connection with
Immigrants Application.

Respectfully yours

Paul Vodovosoff.

Subject Communication dated 1-4-39 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Miss Olga Ilnitsky.

Made by D. S. I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford D. I.

Miss Olga Ippolitovna ILNITSKY, Russian, born
on September 23, 1916 at Harbin. According to her own
statement, she attended a school in Vladivostok from 1924
to 1930 when she left for Manchuria. After a short stay
in that city she proceeded to Chefoo where she continued
her education in a convent until 1934, being supported by
her sister, Miss N. I. Ilnitsky. Some time during 1934 she
arrived in Shanghai from Chefoo and has since been residing
with her sister. Here she is reported to have been em-
ployed as a designer with the Modern Home, 574/878 Bubbling
Well Road, for about six months ( in 1935-1936) and in the
Slovo Printing & Publishing Co., 238 Avenue du Roi Albert,
for a short period. At present she has no fixed employ-
ment.

She is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, Moulmein Road, and the Shanghai City Government
Police Bureau ( Reg. No. 15207 ). She resides at 7/9 Route
de Grouchy together with her sister.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning this person.

According to Miss Ilnitsky, she does not intend
to apply for a visa to enter Australia in the near future,
as she has first to make certain arrangements with her re-
latives residing in that country.

A Prokofiev
D. S. I.

（批：P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) 3/5）
D. C. ( Special Branch ).

奥尔加·伊波利托夫娜·伊尔尼茨基（Olga Ippolitovna ILNITSKY），俄罗斯人，1916年9月23日出生于哈尔滨。据其自述，她于1924年至1930年在海参崴的一所学校就读，随后前往满洲。在该城市短暂停留后，她前往烟台，在一所修道院继续接受教育直至1934年，期间由其姐姐 N. I. 伊尔尼茨基小姐资助。1934年间某时，她从烟台抵达上海，此后一直与姐姐同住。据报道，她在此曾受雇于静安寺路574/878号“现代家庭”（Modern Home）担任设计师约六个月（1935-1936年间），并在阿尔伯特王路238号“斯洛沃印刷出版公司”（Slovo Printing & Publishing Co.）工作过短暂时期。目前她没有固定职业。

她在莫尔缅路俄罗斯侨民委员会和上海市政府警察局登记（注册号 15207）。她与姐姐同住在格罗西路7/9号。

工部局警务处档案中关于此人没有任何记录。

据伊尔尼茨基小姐称，她近期不打算申请进入澳大利亚的签证，因为她首先必须与居住在该国的亲属做出某些安排。

Subject Communication dated 29-4-39 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Mr. J.A. Diakoff.
Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. C. Crawford. S.I.

Ivan Andreyevich DIAKOFF,Russian, was born
on September 9,1891 in Tambov Province, Russia. He claims
to have graduated from the School Teachers Institute at
St.Petersburg in 1910 and from the Philologic Faculty of the
University of St. Petersburg in 1912. According to his
own statement, he left Vladivostok for Manchuria in August,
1922 and for the following three years worked as a teacher
in various schools in Harbin and other places in the Chinese
Eastern Railway Zone, after which he and his two brothers,
N.A. Diakoff and V.A. Diakoff, proceeded to Tsingtao. In
1925-1926 in company with his brother N.A. Diakoff he made
a trip into the interior of China ( Szechuen province )
with the aim of gathering scientific data relating to the
history,ethnography,religion etc. of China. Returning from
the expedition some time towards the end of 1926 he resided
at the Russian Orthodox Mission in Peking until 1928,after
which he proceeded to Harbin to resume his work as a school
teacher. From 1931 to 1937 he resided at Tsingtao where he
is reported to have worked in his professional capacity in
local schools for various periods. In April,1937 he arrived
in Shanghai and after three months stay in this city left
on what he planned to be another scientific expedition into
the interior of China. However, owing to the outbreak of the
Sino-Japanese hostilities he had to abandon his plan
upon reaching Chungking and to stay in that city for a con-
siderable period. On August 15,1938 he returned to Shanghai
via Canton and Hongkong aboard the s.s. Conte Biancamano.
Since that time he has been residing at 84 Route Paul Henry

伊万·安德烈耶维奇·佳科夫（Ivan Andreyevich DIAKOFF），俄罗斯人，1891年9月9日出生于俄国坦波夫省。他声称于1910年毕业于圣彼得堡师范学院，并于1912年毕业于圣彼得堡大学语文系。据其自述，他于1922年8月离开海参崴前往满洲，并在随后的三年里在中东铁路区的哈尔滨及其他地方的各类学校担任教师，之后他与他的两个兄弟 N.A. 佳科夫和 V.A. 佳科夫前往青岛。1925-1926年间，他与兄弟 N.A. 佳科夫一同深入中国内地（四川省）旅行，旨在收集有关中国历史、民族志、宗教等的科学数据。大约在1926年底结束考察返回后，他一直居住在北京的俄罗斯东正教传教团，直到1928年，之后他前往哈尔滨恢复其教师工作。从1931年到1937年，他居住在青岛，据报道他在当地的学校以专业身份工作了不同时期。1937年4月，他抵达上海，在本市停留三个月后，出发进行他计划的另一次深入中国内地的科学考察。然而，由于中日战事爆发，他在抵达重庆后不得不放弃计划，并在该市停留了相当长的一段时间。1938年8月15日，他乘坐“孔特·比安卡马诺”号轮船经广州和香港返回上海。自此以后，他一直居住在亨利路84号

Victor Kazimirovitch BOREIKO, Russian, was
born on February 2, 1919 in Perm Province, Russia.
He is reported to have left Russia together with
his parents in 1920 and to have subsequently resided
in Harbin. He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in
the end of 1933 and in January 1934 entered the Public
and Thomas Hanbury School for Boys, graduating from
same in November 1938. Since February 1939 he has
been studying in the Gregg School of Business, 55 Yuen
Ming Yuen Road. At present he resides at 1112 Yu
Yuen Road, House 20, Apartment C., together with his
aunt, Mrs. A. E. Kogan. Another aunt of his is
married to Mr. E. A. Roche of the Municipal Health
Department.

The applicant is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police
records detrimental to his character.

ker until August,1938, after which he has been working in-
dependently buying raw materials for various local ca-

Heinrich Ivanovich NIEDENS，俄国人，1909年5月13日出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔省（Amur Province）布拉戈维申斯克（Blagoveschensk）。据其自称，他于1930年9月从苏联逃往满洲，并在随后的四年里居住在哈尔滨，在那里他在 Gustav Orpitz 香肠厂担任香肠制作工两年多。1934年8月，他从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此地，他曾在静安寺路的维也纳肉铺（Vienna Butchery）短期受雇，之后受雇于杜福路28/30号（A.Lang & N.Semin 所有）的维也纳香肠厂（Vienna Sausage Factory）。1936年7月，他自愿离职，同年8月加入兆丰路149/59号的 W.Futterer 德式肉铺及香肠厂，并在那里担任香肠制作工直至1938年8月，此后他一直独立经营，为当地各家肠衣出口商采购原材料。

他在莫尔美路的俄国侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局（注册号 16767）登记注册。目前他与妻子 Nadejda Fedorovna Niedens 夫人（婚前姓 Kondrasheff，1908年10月25日出生于布拉戈维申斯克，与其丈夫一同抵达上海）同住于贾菲露台85号。他们有两个女儿，分别名为 Alice（1929年生）和 Raissa（1931年生）。与申请人同住的还有其兄弟 Edward Niedens，24岁；另有三个兄弟 Julius、David 和 Paul，据报目前在德国

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford Y.S

Yakir Yankelevich SHUTTE, Russian of Jewish origin, born on June 10, 1888 at Golovanevsk, Podolsk Province, South Russia. He was formerly a tailor by profession. According to his own statement, he left Russia for South America in 1906 and for the following two or three years resided at Buenos Aires, after which he proceeded to Singapore. There he worked in his professional capacity with G.L. Campbell, Tailors & Outfitters, for several years. Next he resided in Siam for about five years, during which period he claims to have been conducting a second hand furniture and curio shop. In September, 1919 he arrived in Shanghai from Siam.

Here he is reported to have been working as a tailor, being at one time ( 1926-1927 ) employed with C.N. Gray & Co., and also to have been engaged in commercial business on a small scale. He was registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee before 1926, but later obtained either a Brazilian passport or a certificate of Brazilian nationality and until 1934 was regarded as a Brazilian citizen.

His wife, Mrs Ida Froimovna SHUTTE nee Neuman, also a Russian Jewess, born on 15-3-1893 at Kamenetz-Podolsk, is reported to have been residing in Shanghai for many years and was formerly known as Mrs. Edelstein. She kept a boarding house at No 4, Lane 51, Thorne Road, where Shutte also resided, until July, 1932 when the licence was transferred to one Movshevitz. This house bore an unsavoury reputation and while no proof could be ob-

Yakir Yankelevich SHUTTE，犹太裔俄国人，1888年6月10日出生于南俄波多尔斯克省（Podolsk Province）戈洛瓦涅夫斯克（Golovanevsk）。他以前的职业是裁缝。据其自称，他于1906年离开俄国前往南美，在随后的两三年里居住在布宜诺斯艾利斯，之后前往新加坡。在那里，他在 G.L. Campbell 裁缝与服饰店从事本行工作数年。接着，他在暹罗居住了约五年，在此期间，他声称经营一家二手家具和古玩店。1919年9月，他从暹罗抵达上海。

据报他在这里从事裁缝工作，曾在某一时期（1926-1927年）受雇于 C.N. Gray & Co.，也曾小规模从事商业活动。他在1926年之前已在俄国侨民委员会注册，但后来获得了巴西护照或巴西国籍证明书，直到1934年一直被视为巴西公民。

其妻子 Ida Froimovna SHUTTE 夫人（婚前姓 Neuman），也是俄国犹太女子，1893年3月15日出生于卡缅涅茨-波多利斯基（Kamenetz-Podolsk），据报在上海居住多年，以前被称为 Edelstein 夫人。她在索恩路51弄4号经营一家寄宿公寓，Shutte 也住在那里，直到1932年7月执照转让给 Movshevitz。这所房子名声不佳，虽然无法获得确凿证

1932年6月14日，Shutte 为位于百老汇路504号、名为“波特兰咖啡馆”（Portland Cafe）的场所申请带酒牌的餐厅执照。该执照未获警务处处长批准，Shutte 也收到了相应通知。然而，尽管执照申请被拒，Shutte 仍于1932年6月29日开设了“波特兰咖啡馆”，并开始销售葡萄酒和烈酒，以此公然违抗警方。警方曾申请传票起诉，但该诉讼被巴西领事馆撤销。他将餐厅营业至1932年10月3日，当时巴西领事馆命令其关闭。

警方最终获得证实，该处正在进行赌博和吸食鸦片活动

1933年10月，接获情报称“友爱俱乐部”（Club Fraternidade）在爱文义路（Avenue Road）1125-1133号开始进行赌博活动。经查询发现，Yakir Shutte（音译）和Wong Chin Nan（音译）两人已获巴西总领事授权开设该俱乐部；事实上，该授权载于一封由总领事签署的信件中，该信被装裱并悬挂在其中一间房间的墙上。一份由Yakir Shutte签署的市政登记表显示其为该俱乐部的负责人。警方获得了该俱乐部从事非法活动的确证，但该俱乐部因资金短缺，于1933年12月5日停业。

1933年12月27日，Yakir Shutte致函上海工部局（捐务处），信函日期为1933年12月27日，声明他不再负责爱文义路1125-1133号处所的市政税项，并称“友爱俱乐部”已关闭。

In the beginning of February,1934 the so-called "Club Social" was opened at House 1,Lane 1475 Avenue Road. The premises were registered at the Revenue Department,S.M.C., in the name of Y. Shutte. It was ascertained that the "club" was nothing but a gambling den.

As by that time sufficient proof was available that Shutte's claim on Brazilian nationality was extremely doubtful, a warrant of arrest against him was obtained from the S.S.D. Court and on 25-2-34 he was arrested on a charge of Conducting Public Gambling. Despite his protest supported by the local Brazilian Consul-General,Shutte was tried by the S.S.D.Court and on 7-3-34 sentenced to 2 years imprisonment and $ 3,000 fine. Shutte filed an appeal with the result that on 16-4-34 the Appeal Court reduced the original sentence to I year of imprisonment and $1,000 fine. During the trial Shutte inter alia stated that he had been ordered by the Chancellor of the Brazilian Consulate to take the position of manager of the " club" under pain of losing his Brazilian citizenship.

On 15-2-35 the local Brazilian Consul-General sent to the Commissioner of Police a list of 22 persons-mostly Russian Jews- stating that these persons were not recognized by him as Brazilian citizens,because the Brazilian passports in their possession had been obtained by means of fraud and false declarations and therefore were of no value whatsoever. The names of Harry Shutte and Mrs Ida Shutte were included in the list,which is sug-

鉴于当时已有充分证据表明Shutte声称拥有巴西国籍一事极不可靠，遂从特区法院取得对其逮捕令，并于1934年2月25日以“经营公开赌博”罪名将其逮捕。尽管当地巴西总领事支持其抗议，Shutte仍由特区法院审理，并于1934年3月7日被判处两年监禁及罚款3,000美元。Shutte提出上诉，上诉法院于1934年4月16日将原判减为一年监禁及罚款1,000美元。在审判期间，Shutte除其他事项外还陈述称，他是受巴西领事馆秘书长的命令担任该“俱乐部”经理的，否则将面临失去巴西公民身份的后果。

Subject D.A. Oussoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S. Pavloff Forwarded by C. Crawford C.D.

Dimitry Alexandrovitch OUSSOFF, Russian, was born on November 5, 1913 in Harbin, Manchuria. In 1924 he left Harbin for Mukden, where in 1930 he graduated from a local high school. During the same year he proceeded to Chefoo and entered the Yih Wen Commercial College in that city. He left the college in October 1931 and in November of the same year arrived in Shanghai. From December 1931 to June 1932 he was employed as an agent with the Associated Advertisers, 101 Nanking Road. Leaving that place of employment owing to a reduction in staff he obtained a position with the Russian daily newspaper "Shanghai Zaria," as a supervisor of night work. He worked in that concern until June 1935 after which he secured a position as a radio-mechanic with the Brunswick Show Room, 1222 Avenue Joffre. In March 1938 he left that place of employment on his own accord and later worked in the same capacity with the Radio Doctor Service, 32 Route Cardinal Mercier. In October 1938 he secured his present position as a radio mechanic with the Scientific Service Company, 142 Museum Road.

The applicant is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.

While in Shanghai, he did not come to the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities of an undesirable nature.

（批：J.B.R. P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 12/5）

Dimitry Alexandrovitch OUSSOFF，俄国人，1913年11月5日出生于满洲哈尔滨。1924年他离开哈尔滨前往沈阳，并于1930年毕业于当地一所高中。同年他前往烟台，进入该市的益文商业专科学校就读。他于1931年10月离校，并于同年11月抵达上海。从1931年12月至1932年6月，他受雇于南京路101号的联合广告公司（Associated Advertisers）担任代理人。后因裁员离开该职，他在俄文日报《上海霞报》（Shanghai Zaria）获得了一份夜班主管的工作。他在该机构工作至1935年6月，之后在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）1222号的布伦瑞克陈列室（Brunswick Show Room）谋得无线电技师一职。1938年3月，他自愿离职，随后在梅神父路（Route Cardinal Mercier）32号的无线电医生服务处（Radio Doctor Service）担任同等职务。1938年10月，他获得现任职位，即在博物馆路142号的科学服务公司（Scientific Service Company）担任无线电技师。

申请人已在慕尔鸣路118/1号的俄国侨民委员会登记。

在上海期间，他未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警方的注意。

Subject. T.G. Stoliaroff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by. D.S. Iavloff. .................... Forwarded by C. Gasford.

Efim Georgievitch STOLIAROFF, Russian, was
born on November 3, 1903 in Altai Province, Russia.
He is reported to have left Russia in 1923 and to
have subsequently resided in Tientsin. He arrived
in Shanghai from Tientsin in August 1925 and in
December of the same year obtained a position as a
chauffeur with the Shanghai Milk Supply Company,
145 Tunsin Road. In the end of 1932 he left that
employment on his own accord and later worked
casually as a service station attendant and as a
chauffeur. Early in 1934 he was engaged as a
chauffeur by Mrs. K. Koreneff, 92 Lincoln Avenue.
In April 1937 his services were dispensed with, due
to Mrs. Koreneff's marriage to Mr. Hicks, ex-sergeant
of the Shanghai Municipal Police and to their
subsequent departure to Australia. In August 1937
the applicant secured his present position as a
chauffeur with the British Military Control.

Vera Ivanovna STOLIAROFF, nee Korkishkova,
Russian, was born on December 17, 1910 in Maritime
Province, Russia. She is reported to have resided
in Tientsin since 1921. She married the applicant
on May 19, 1925 and has since been residing together
with him. For the past three years she has been
employed as a nurse with the Russian Orthodox
Confraternity's Hospital.

Made by D.S. Karloff Forwarded by C. Crawford

Alexander Ivanovitch STERELNY, Russian,
was born on March 1, 1881 in Volynsk Province,
Russia. According to his own statement he left
Russia in 1917 and subsequently resided in
Yokohama, Japan, until 1921 after which he
proceeded to Shanghai. In 1923 he secured a
position as an assistant accountant with the New
Engineering & Shipbuilding Works Ltd. At present
he holds a position of the chief accountant with
the same concern which at present is known as
Shanghai Dockyards Ltd.

Ekaterina Neonilovna Sterelny, nee Schultz,
Russian, wife of the applicant, was born on
September 16, 1889 in Ekaterinoslav, Russia.
She married the applicant in 1916, at Vladivostok
and has since been residing together with him.

Margarita Alexandrovna Sterelny, daughter
of the applicant, was born on April 6, 1917 at
Vladivostok, Maritime Province, Russia. She
arrived in Shanghai together with her parents.
In 1927 she proceeded to Chefoo where she entered
the Sacred Heart Convent, graduating from same in
1933. She returned to Shanghai during the same
year and resided together with her parents until
August 1938, after which she proceeded to Tsingtao,
where at present she is on the teaching staff of
the Holy Ghost Convent in that city.

Alexander Ivanovitch STERELNY，俄国人，

助理会计师一职。目前，他在同一家公司担任总会计师，该公司
现名为上海船坞有限公司（Shanghai Dockyards Ltd.）。

Ekaterina Neonilovna Sterelny，娘家姓 Schultz，
俄国人，申请人之妻，于 1889 年 9 月 16 日出生于俄罗斯叶卡捷琳诺斯拉夫（Ekaterinoslav）。
她于 1916 年在符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostok）与申请人结婚，
此后一直与其共同居住。

Margarita Alexandrovna Sterelny，申请人之女，
于 1917 年 4 月 6 日出生于俄罗斯滨海省（Maritime Province）符拉迪沃斯托克。
她与父母一同抵达上海。
1927 年，她前往烟台，进入圣心女修院（Sacred Heart Convent），并于
1933 年从该院毕业。同年她返回上海，与父母同住至
1938 年 8 月，之后前往青岛，
目前她在该市圣灵女修院（Holy Ghost Convent）任教。

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

My son Igor, prefect of the Thomas Hanbury
School for Boys intends to join the Hawkesbury
Agricultural College in Richmond N.S.W. Australia.

For the purpose of receiving the permit to
enter Australia a certificate is required by the
Commonwealth Government to the effect that neither
my son nor other members of my family, i.e. myself,
wife and daughter have been here in prison or a
mental hospital.

I shall feel much obliged if you will kind-
ly issue such a certificate which will enable my son
to continue his studies.

Yours faithfully,
A. J. Sterelny.

Subject. Communication dated 20-5-39 from the British Consulate-General con-
cerning V.F. Jookoff applicant for admission to Australia.
Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by C. Claxton. I.S.

Vassily Fomich JOOKOFF, Russian, born on
March 6, 1896 in Kuban region, Russia. A cossack of the
Kuban clan by origin he claims to have graduated from the
Military Assistant Surgeons School at Ekaterinodar in
1913. According to his own statement, he left Russia
for Persia in August, 1917 and later made his way to the
Far East via Mesopotamia and India, arriving in this ci-
ty in February, 1922. Here he worked casually as a massa-
gist until March, 1924 when he secured employment with
Stey's Dairy Farm & Ice Factory, 92 Edinburgh Road. When
the enterprise was sold to a Chinese company in August,
1929, Jookoff continued to serve as manager of the dairy
farm until May, 1932 when he resigned. He holds good tes-
timonials from his employers. From 1-11-32 he is re-
ported to have been operating a dairy farm at 221 Tunsin
Road on behalf of the Shanghai Milk Supply Company, Ltd.

He resides at 221 Tunsin Road together with
his wife, Mrs Efrosinia Gerasimovna Jookoff nee Koshelkin,
born on 6-10-1900, who arrived in Shanghai together with
her husband. They have two sons named George ( born
26-12-1919 in Persia) and Mihail ( born 4-9-1922 at
Shanghai). The elder son is reported to have left for
Australia in 1936, and Mihail attends the Public and
Thos. Hanbury School for Boys.

The Jockoff family are registered with the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police re-
cords concerning these persons.

D. C. ( Special Branch)        A. Prokopiev
                               D.S.I.

（左下角批注：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 22/5）

制作人。D.S.I. Prokofiev。    转呈人 C. Claxton. I.S.

Vassily Fomich JOOKOFF，俄国人，1896 年
3 月 6 日出生于俄罗斯库班地区（Kuban region）。他自称出身库班哥萨克氏族，
并于 1913 年毕业于叶卡捷琳诺达尔（Ekaterinodar）的军事助理外科医生学校。
据其本人陈述，他于 1917 年 8 月离开俄罗斯前往波斯，
后经美索不达米亚和印度前往远东，于 1922 年 2 月抵达本市。
在此地，他从事按摩师零工，直至 1924 年 3 月受雇于
爱丁堡路 92 号的 Stey's 乳品厂及制冰厂（Stey's Dairy Farm & Ice Factory）。
当该企业于 1929 年 8 月出售给一家中国公司时，Jookoff 继续担任
乳品厂经理，直至 1932 年 5 月辞职。他持有雇主出具的
良好推荐信。据报道，自 1932 年 11 月 1 日起，他代表
上海牛奶供应有限公司（Shanghai Milk Supply Company, Ltd.）在
通新路（Tunsin Road）221 号经营一家乳品厂。

他与妻子 Efrosinia Gerasimovna Jookoff 夫人（娘家姓 Koshelkin，
1900 年 10 月 6 日出生）居住在通新路 221 号，她是与丈夫一同
抵达上海的。他们有两个儿子，名叫 George（1919 年 12 月 26 日出生于波斯）
和 Mihail（1922 年 9 月 4 日出生于上海）。据报道，长子已于
1936 年前往澳大利亚，Mihail 就读于公和洋行及
托马斯·汉伯里男校（Public and Thos. Hanbury School for Boys）。

Jockoff 家族已在慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）的
俄国侨民委员会登记。

工部局警务处档案中关于这些人没有任何记录。

D. C. (特务科)        A. Prokopiev
                               D.S.I.

（左下角批注：P.A. 致 D.C. (特务科) 5月22日）

Made by D.S. Pavloff. Forwarded by C. Gasko. dy

Mrs. Vassa Ivanovna VOLOJANINA, nee
Bobkova, Russian, was born on August 25, 1888
in Poltava Province, Russia. She married
Mr. V.C. Volojanin in 1921 at Vladivostok and
is reported to have left Russia for China during
the same year and to have subsequently resided in
Tientsin, Changchun and Harbin for various periods.
She arrived in Shanghai together with her husband
in 1927 and has since been residing together with
her son-in-law, Mr. Stoliaroff, a chauffeur
employed by the British Military Control.
On April 5, 1938, her husband,
Mr. V.C. Volojanin , was sentenced by the 1st
Shanghai Special District Court to 50 days'
imprisonment on a charge of larceny.
The applicant is registered with the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.
There is nothing in the Municipal
Police records detrimental to her character.
Mrs. V.I. Volojanina is unable to read or
write Russian or any other language.
A. S. Pavloff
D. S.

Vassa Ivanovna VOLOJANINA 夫人，娘家姓
Bobkova，俄国人，1888 年 8 月 25 日出生于
俄罗斯波尔塔瓦省（Poltava Province）。她于 1921 年在符拉迪沃斯托克
与 V.C. Volojanin 先生结婚，
据报道同年离开俄罗斯前往中国，并随后在
天津、长春和哈尔滨居住过不同时期。
她于 1927 年与丈夫一同抵达上海，此后一直与
其女婿 Stoliaroff 先生同住，Stoliaroff 先生是一名受雇于

Vassily Osipovitch VOLOJANIN, Russian,
was born on April 26, 1896 in Transbaikal Province,
Russia. He is reported to have left Russia in
1921 and to have resided for various periods at
Tientsin, Changchun and Harbin. He arrived in
Shanghai from Harbin in 1927 and has since been
residing together with his son-in-law, Mr. Stoliaroff,

During his stay here he was employed as a kennel
man at Canidrome from 1930 to 1934, after which he
has been unemployed.
On April 5, 1938 he was sentenced by the
1st Shanghai Special District Court to 50 days'
imprisonment on a charge of Larceny.

Egor Petrovitch MASHIN, Russian, was born
on July 24, 1916 in Harbin, Manchuria. He arrived
in Shanghai from Harbin in 1925 together with his
parents. In 1926 he entered the 1st Russian School
(now A.S. Poushkin Memorial School), graduating from
same in 1933. In September of the same year he
entered the evening classes of the Henry Lester
Institute of Technical Education (Building Department),
505 Seward Road. He is reported to have completed
his studies in May of the present year. Since
December 1938 he has been employed as a supervisor
with the Cathay Ceramics (H.K.) Ltd., 346 Szechuen
Road.

The applicant has two brothers, one of
whom is employed with River Police in Shanghai and
the other with the Transport Department of Melchers
& Company.

The applicant is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police
records detrimental to his character.

D. S. Pavloff.

concerning Cleopatra Shvetz.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C Crawford. D.D.

Cleopatra Nikolaevna SHVETZ, naturalized
Chinese citizen of Russian origin, born on October
5, 1912 at Listvenichnaya, Irkutsk Province,
Siberia. She is reported to have left Russia for
Manchuria in 1922 together with her parents and for
the following ten years to have resided first at
Pogranichnaya Station, Chinese Eastern Railway, and
later at Harbin. According to her own statement,
she graduated from a middle school in the latter
city in 1931. In October, 1932 she arrived in
Shanghai from Harbin. Here she is reported to
have been employed as a shop assistant at Tkachenko's
Bakery & Confectionery, 640-642 Avenue Joffre, after
which she worked as a manicurist in the Modern
Beauty Parlour, Bubbling Well Road, for about one
year, and in Jan's Beauty Parlour, 1149 Bubbling
Well Road, for about two years.

On 24-10-34 she married one L.R. FURMAN,
Russian of Jewish extraction, a barber by occupation,
at present employed in Jan's Beauty Parlour. They
have one son named Roman, born on 17-9-35 at Shanghai.

Mrs. Furman-Shvetz resides at House 3,
Lane 25, Route Tenant de La Tour, at which address
her mother conducts a small boarding-house. She is
registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
Moulmein Road, on the strength of Chinese passport
No.11426.

撰写人：D.S.I. Prokofiev。转呈人：C Crawford。D.D.

克莱奥帕特拉·尼古拉耶夫娜·什韦茨（Cleopatra Nikolaevna SHVETZ），原籍俄国的归化中国公民，1912 年 10 月 5 日出生于西伯利亚伊尔库茨克省的 Listvenichnaya。据报她于 1922 年与父母一同离开俄国前往满洲，并在随后的十年间先居住在中东铁路的 Pogranichnaya 车站，后居住于哈尔滨。据其自称，她于 1931 年毕业于该市的一所中学。1932 年 10 月，她从哈尔滨抵达上海。据报她在此之后曾在霞飞路 640-642 号的 Tkachenko 面包糖果店担任店员，随后在静安寺路的 Modern Beauty Parlour 担任美甲师约一年，并在静安寺路 1149 号的 Jan's Beauty Parlour 工作约两年。

1934 年 10 月 24 日，她与 L.R. FURMAN 结婚，Furman 为犹太裔俄国人，职业为理发师，目前受雇于 Jan's Beauty Parlour。他们育有一子，名为 Roman，1935 年 9 月 17 日出生于上海。

Furman-Shvetz 夫人居住在坦拿德路 25 弄 3 号，其母在该地址经营一家小型寄宿公寓。她凭中国护照第 11426 号在慕尔鸣路的俄国侨民委员会登记。

REPORT
File No. **〔此处转录不清〕**
No. S A 1).
Date May 31, 19 39

Subject. I.Y. Stepanoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by. D.S. Pavloff. Forwarded by. C. Crawford. O.V.

Ivan Yakovlevitch STEPANOFF, Russian,
was born on January 1, 1896 at Kazan, Russia.
He is reported to have resided in Harbin from
1920 to 1936. According to his own statement,
whilst in Harbin, he was employed with the
Chinese Eastern Railway for a period and from
March 1931 to May 1932 as a Russian Secretary
of the Political Section of the Harbin Police.
After the inauguration of the Manchoukuo State
he worked as a translator with the Japanese
Gendarmerie in Harbin. However, for reasons un-
known he was obliged to leave Harbin in October
1936 and proceeded to Peking, where soon after
his arrival, he obtained a position as a Russian
Secretary and a translator with the Political
Section of the Peking Police. Following the
occupation of Peking by Japanese Forces, he
resided in Tientsin for a period and after the
fall of the latter city proceeded to Shanghai,
arriving here in November 1937.

At present he is engaged in commercial
business, acting as a private salesman for
various local firms.

Dominica Victorovna Stepanoff, nee
Ignatenko, Russian, wife of the applicant, was
born on January 1, 1902 in Harkov Province,
Russia. She married the applicant in 1924 at
Harbin and has since been residing together
with him.

撰写人：D.S. Pavloff。转呈人：C. Crawford。O.V.

伊万·雅科夫列维奇·斯捷潘诺夫（Ivan Yakovlevitch STEPANOFF），俄国人，1896 年 1 月 1 日出生于俄国喀山。据报他于 1920 年至 1936 年间居住在哈尔滨。据其自称，在哈尔滨期间，他曾受雇于中东铁路一段时间，并于 1931 年 3 月至 1932 年 5 月期间担任哈尔滨警察厅政治科的俄文秘书。伪满洲国成立后，他在哈尔滨的日本宪兵队担任翻译。然而，由于不明原因，他不得不于 1936 年 10 月离开哈尔滨前往北平，抵达后不久便在北平警察厅政治科获得俄文秘书兼翻译的职位。北平被日军占领后，他在天津居住了一段时间，天津沦陷后前往上海，于 1937 年 11 月抵达此地。

目前他从事商业活动，担任多家本地商行的私人推销员。

多米尼卡·维克托罗夫娜·斯捷潘诺娃（Dominica Victorovna Stepanoff），娘家姓伊格纳坚科（Ignatenko），俄国人，申请人的妻子，1902 年 1 月 1 日出生于俄国哈尔科夫省。她于 1924 年在哈尔滨与申请人结婚，此后一直与其共同居住。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch, Shanghai.
REPORT
Date May 31, 1939

Subject. Communication dated 30-5-39 from the British Consulate-General
concerning E. Kurlansky, applicant for a visa to enter Australia.

Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. C. Crawford. D.I.

Evsey Eleazarovich KURLANSKY, Russian of Jew-
ish extraction, born on November 19, 1911 at Nikolaevsk-on-
Amur, Siberia. He is reported to have arrived in Shanghai
in 1923 from Japan where he had attended a school ( the
Canadian Academy ) at Kobe for about four years. Here he
resided together with his mother and step-father ( Sub-
Inspector E.A.G. Verschaer of the Shanghai Municipal Po-
lice ) until June, 1928 when he joined the Russian Regiment,
S.V.C. Upon leaving this service in November, 1930 he was
employed with the Shanghai Telephone Company from January,
1931 to October, 1932 when he joined the Shanghai Municipal
Police as a Probationary Sergeant. In October, 1937 he
was granted seven months leave. While being absent from
Shanghai he tendered his resignation from the date of ex-
piration of his leave. ( 5-5-38 ).

It appears that when proceeding on leave he
obtained a "tourist" visa for the U.S.A. valid for seven
months and that he spent the greater part of his leave in
Honolulu. Upon the expiration of the visa he was obliged
to return to Shanghai, arriving here on 10-6-38 in the s.s.
"Shanghai Maru". Shortly afterwards, it is reported, he
made an unsuccessful application for an immigration visa
to the United States.

On August 6, 1938 he was re-engaged in the
Shanghai Municipal Police in the rank of Sergeant.

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, Moulmein Road, and with the Shanghai City Go-
vernment Police Bureau.

D.C. ( Special Branch )
A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

（左下角批注：P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) 3/6）

报告
日期：1939年5月31日

事由：英国总领事馆于1939年5月30日来函，关于申请进入澳大利亚签证的申请人 E. Kurlansky。

制作人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）。转呈人：督察克劳福德（C. Crawford）。

叶夫谢·埃莱阿扎罗维奇·库尔兰斯基（Evsey Eleazarovich KURLANSKY），俄籍犹太人，1911年11月19日出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔河畔尼古拉耶夫斯克（Nikolaevsk-on-Amur）。据报他于1923年从日本抵达上海，此前他在神户的一所名为“加拿大学院”（Canadian Academy）的学校就读约四年。在此期间，他与母亲及继父（上海公共租界工部局警务处副督察 E.A.G. Verschaer）共同居住，直至1928年6月加入俄国军团（Russian Regiment），即上海义勇队（S.V.C.）。1930年11月离开该部队后，他于1931年1月至1932年10月受雇于上海电话公司，随后于1932年10月以试用巡长身份加入上海公共租界工部局警务处。1937年10月，他获准休假七个月。在离开上海期间，他自休假期满之日起提出辞职（1938年5月5日）。

据悉，他在休假期前获得了一份有效期为七个月的美国“旅游”签证，并将大部分休假时间花在檀香山。签证期满后，他不得不返回上海，于1938年6月10日乘坐“上海丸”号轮船（s.s. "Shanghai Maru"）抵达此地。据报道，不久之后，他申请美国移民签证未获成功。

1938年8月6日，他被上海公共租界工部局警务处重新录用，职级为巡长。

他在慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局均有登记。

特务科助理总监
A. 普罗科菲耶夫
副督察

（左下角批注：P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) 3/6）

Subject N.A. Soldatenko, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. S.I.

Nikolai Alexandrovich SOLDATENKO, Soviet citizen of Russian origin, born on December 6, 1910 at Berdiansk, South Russia. According to his own statement, he arrived in Manchuria from the U.S.S.R. in 1925 and for the following ten years resided in Harbin where he worked first as an apprentice in local barber shops and later was employed as a hairdresser. He also stated that while in Harbin he took out emigrant papers, but in 1931 was obliged to again become a Soviet citizen in order to keep his employment as a hairdresser at the Railway Club in that city.

He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on 3-10-35 aboard the s.s. "Tsingtao Maru" travelling on Soviet passport No. 22600 issued on 4-4-31 at Harbin. Here he is reported to have been employed in his professional capacity at Victor's European Beauty Parlour, 2 North Szechuen Road, for the past three years. At present he resides at 310 Route Vallon together with his wife, Mrs Elisabeth I. Soldatenko nee Videman, born 19-12-1910 at Harbin and their daughter Valentina born 13-2-1930 at Harbin. Mrs. Soldatenko arrived in Shanghai in 1935.

On April 20, 1939 Soldatenko called at the Russian Emigrants Committee, Moulmein Road, and stated that he decided to renounce his allegiance to the Soviet Government. He surrendered registration certificate No 16843 issued by the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau on 8-10-36, in which it is stated that he is a Soviet citizen and applied for an emigrant passport. 事由：N.A. Soldatenko，品行证明书申请人。

制作人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫。转呈人：督察克劳福德。

尼古拉·亚历山德罗维奇·索尔达坚科（Nikolai Alexandrovich SOLDATENKO），俄裔苏联公民，1910年12月6日出生于俄罗斯南部别尔江斯克（Berdiansk）。据其自述，他于1925年从苏联抵达满洲，并在随后的十年间居住在哈尔滨，起初在当地理发店当学徒，后来受雇为理发师。他还称，在哈尔滨期间他曾办理侨民证件，但为了保持在该市铁路俱乐部担任理发师的职位，不得不在1931年重新成为苏联公民。

他于1935年10月3日从哈尔滨乘坐“青岛丸”号轮船（s.s. "Tsingtao Maru"）抵达上海，持有一本1931年4月4日在哈尔滨签发的苏联护照，号码为22600。据报道，过去三年里，他在四川北路2号维克多欧式美容院（Victor's European Beauty Parlour）从事本专业工作。目前，他与妻子伊丽莎白·I·索尔达坚科夫人（原名维德曼 Videman，1910年12月19日出生于哈尔滨）及女儿瓦伦蒂娜（Valentina，1930年2月13日出生于哈尔滨）居住在法租界华伦路（Route Vallon）310号。索尔达坚科夫人于1935年抵达上海。

1939年4月20日，索尔达坚科前往慕尔鸣路俄国侨民委员会，声明决定放弃对苏联政府的效忠。他交回了由上海市政府警察局于1936年10月8日签发的第16843号登记证，该证注明其为苏联公民，并申请了侨民护照。此事正**〔此处转录不清〕**

To the Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

In connection with my application for a visa
to enter Australia, I have the honour to request a certifi-
cate from the Municipal Police regarding my political re-
liableness.

I state for your information that I never be-
longed and do not belong at present to any political organi-
zation and was never charged with any offence before a
court.

I am a hairdresser by occupation and have
been residing in Shanghai since 1936 together with my wife
and daughter.

(Signed): N.A. Soldatenko

310 Route Vallon,
Shanghai.

Subject Communication dated 24-5-39 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Mr. O. Mihailoff, applicant for a visa to enter Australia.
Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. C. Crawford.

Oleg Georgievich MIHAILOFF, Russian, born on
September 7, 1914 at Petrograd, Russia. Son of an offi-
cer of the Russian Navy he is reported to have arrived
in Shanghai from Vladivostok via Nagasaki in 1921 toge-
ther with his mother and step-father Mr. V.G. Longworth.
Here he attended the French Municipal College and the
Public School for short periods, after which he studied
in the St. Francis Xavier's College from 1925 to 1931.
Upon leaving the latter school he attended the Shanghai
Business College, 19 Kiukiang Road, for several months
and from 1934 has been employed at the Canidrome, 439 Ave-
nue du Roi Albert, as a kennelman.

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, Moulmein Road, and at present resides at 48
Route Dollfus.

His mother is reported to be now married to
Mr. S. von Feldman, manager of Lucerne Dairy, Lincoln
Avenue.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police re-
cords concerning this person.

A. Prokopieff
D. S. I.

（批：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 2/6.）

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

奥列格·格奥尔基耶维奇·米哈伊洛夫（Oleg Georgievich MIHAILOFF），俄国人，1914年9月7日出生于俄罗斯彼得格勒。据报他是俄国海军军官之子，于1921年与其母亲及继父 V.G. Longworth 先生一起，经长崎从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。在此地，他曾在法公董局学校和公立学校短暂就读，随后于1925年至1931年间在圣方济各沙勿略学院（St. Francis Xavier's College）学习。离开该校后，他在九江路19号的上海商业专科学校学习了几个月，自1934年起受雇于阿尔贝王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）439号的逸园跑狗场（Canidrome），担任犬舍管理员。

他在慕尔鸣路的俄国侨民委员会登记，目前居住在达尔福斯路（Route Dollfus）48号。

据报道，他的母亲现已嫁给林肯大道（Lincoln Avenue）卢塞恩乳品厂（Lucerne Dairy）经理 S. von Feldman 先生。

工部局警务处档案中关于此人没有任何记录。

A. 普罗科皮耶夫
副督察

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ENTRY
S.I., Special Branch    826 D.S.
REPORT    Date June 12, 1939.

Subject Ignac Kleinberger - application for certificate of character.

Made by. D.S.I. MacAdie,    Forwarded by. C. [Signature]

Ignac Kleinberger was born of Jewish parents
on January 25th 1911 at Brzesco then in Austro-Hungary
but subsequent to the Great War in Polish territory.
He is therefore a Polish citizen and is in possession
of a Polish passport No. 9163a/4/36 issued by the
Polish Consulate in Berlin. The document, however,
is no longer valid having expired on March 22nd, this
year. At the age of nine months applicant was taken
by his parents to Berlin where he has stayed until
emigrating to the Far East last year. Although a
Polish citizen, he is ignorant of the Polish language,
his mother tongue being German.

Applicant arrived in Shanghai from Europe on
1938
August 19th by the Dairen Maru having travelled via
Siberia. He registered with the International Committee
(No. 3192) and obtained accommodation in the
Salvation Army Hostel, No. 7 Yang Terrace where he is
still staying. In October 1938 he obtained a position
as a salesman in the Hardware Department of Messrs.
Whiteaway & Laidlaw, Nanking Road, which position he
still holds.

Kleinberger is in possession of a certificate
of good conduct dated July 29th 1938 issued by the
Berlin Police and stating that he has resided in that
city since November 19th, 1911. He is spoken highly
of by the Salvation Army officials with whom he has
come into contact since his stay in Shanghai.

事由：Ignac Kleinberger - 申请品行证明书。

制作人：副督察麦卡迪（MacAdie），    转呈人：C. [签名]

伊格纳茨·克莱因伯格（Ignac Kleinberger）出生于犹太父母家庭，1911年1月25日出生于布热斯科（Brzesco），当时属奥匈帝国，一战后归属波兰领土。因此他是波兰公民，持有柏林波兰领事馆签发的波兰护照，号码为9163a/4/36。然而，该证件已于今年3月22日过期，不再有效。申请人在九个月大时被父母带往柏林，并一直居住在那里，直到去年移居远东。虽然是波兰公民，但他不懂波兰语，其母语为德语。

申请人于1938年8月19日经西伯利亚乘坐“大连丸”号（Dairen Maru）从欧洲抵达上海。他在国际委员会登记（编号3192），并在杨树浦路7号救世军招待所（Salvation Army Hostel）获得住宿，目前仍居住于此。1938年10月，他在南京路怀特威与莱德劳公司（Whiteaway & Laidlaw）五金部获得售货员职位，该职位他一直保留至今。

克莱因伯格持有柏林警察于1938年7月29日签发的行为良好证书，注明他自1911年11月19日起居住在该市。自他居住上海以来，与他有过接触的救世军官员对他评价很高。

Date June 13, 1939

Subject A.P. Nikitin, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. C. Crawford

Andrei Petrovich NIKITIN, Russian, born on
October 5, 1914 in Omsk Province, Siberia. He is reported
to have arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok via Genzan
in September, 1923 aboard the s.s. "Eldorado" together with
his elder sister who subsequently married one S.K. Bur-
mistroff in Shanghai. The applicant attended the French
Municipal College from 1924 to 1928 and the Thomas Hanbu-
ry School from 1928 to 1931. Upon leaving the latter
school he worked as an apprentice in the Linotype & Machi-
nery Ltd., 160 Avenue Edward VII for about 9 months in
1932 - 1933, after which he was employed as a linotype me-
chanic and overseer at the Mercury Press until October,
1933. From April to November, 1934 he was employed in a
similar capacity with the "Journal de Shanghai", 23 Rue
du Consulat. On 24-12-35, after a period of unemployment,
he joined the Russian Auxiliary Detachment of the French
Police, in which he is still serving.

The applicant is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road.

According to his own statement, a friend of
his, a Russian residing in Australia, will apply on his
behalf for a visa to enter that country.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police re-
cords concerning this person.

A. Prokopiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

制作人。 副督察长 Prokofiev. 转呈人。 C. Crawford

Andrei Petrovich NIKITIN，俄罗斯人，1914年10月5日出生于西伯利亚鄂木斯克省。据报，他于1923年9月与其姐姐一同乘坐“埃尔多拉多”号 (s.s. "Eldorado") 轮船，经元山 (Genzan) 从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。其姐姐随后在上海嫁给了 S.K. Burmistroff。申请人于1924年至1928年就读于法公董局学校 (French Municipal College)，1928年至1931年就读于汉璧礼西童公学 (Thomas Hanbury School)。离开该校后，他于1932-1933年间在爱文义路160号的莱诺铸排机与机械有限公司 (Linotype & Machinery Ltd.) 做了约9个月的学徒，之后受雇于《水星报》馆 (Mercury Press) 担任莱诺铸排机技工和监工，直至1933年10月。1934年4月至11月，他在领事馆路23号的《上海日报》(Journal de Shanghai) 担任类似职务。1935年12月24日，经过一段失业期后，他加入了法国警察的俄罗斯辅助分队 (Russian Auxiliary Detachment)，目前仍在该队服役。

申请人已在慕尔鸣路的俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。

据其自称，他的一位居住在澳大利亚的俄罗斯朋友将代表他申请进入该国的签证。

在工部局警务处的记录中，没有关于此人的任何记载。

A. Prokopiev
副督察长 (D. S. I.)

分区警官 (特别科)。

REPORT
File No. 8264/356
Date June 16, 19 39.

Subject. Application by Mr. N. J. Moalem (British) for a
certificate of character
Made by. D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by. C [签名]

With reference to the attached letter dated
June 14th 1939, from Mr. N.J. Moalem, 374/2 Kiangse
Road, requesting a certificate of character, enquiries
failed to reveal anything derogatory to Mr. Moalem's
character.

Nissim Joseph Moalem was born in Shanghai of
British parents on July 19th 1914. He is in possession
of a British passport No.8823 issued at Shanghai on
February 24th 1932 which is valid until February 24th
1942. Mr. Moalem was educated at the S.M.C. Public
School for Boys. After leaving school he obtained
employment as an apprentice mechanic in China Motors,
Fed. Inc. in U.S.A. in 1932. In 1935, he left China
Motors and obtained a better position in Aircraft
China Ltd., 81 Jinkee Road, which he retained for a
few months until the local works of that concern were
closed. Since October 1936 he has been in charge of
the Down Town Garage, on the site of the old Central
Police Station, at Foochow and Honan Roads' corner.

Mr. Moalem resides with his widowed mother
Mrs. Sophie Shuker Moalem at 374 (Apt. 2) Kiangse Road.

In appearance, Mr. Moalem is very dark skinned
and might pass as a certain type of Indian though
actually he is Jew.

D.C. (Special Branch).

[签名]
D. S. I.

    Nissim Joseph Moalem 于1914年7月19日出生于上海，父母均为英国人。他持有1932年2月24日在上海签发的英国护照，号码为8823，有效期至1942年2月24日。Moalem 先生曾在工部局公立男校接受教育。离校后，他于1932年在美国联邦股份有限公司旗下的中国汽车公司 (China Motors, Fed. Inc. in U.S.A.) 获得了一份机械学徒的工作。1935年，他离开中国汽车公司，在金基路81号的中国飞机有限公司 (Aircraft China Ltd.) 获得了一个更好的职位，但仅保留了几个月，直到该公司的本地工厂关闭。自1936年10月以来，他一直负责位于福州路与河南路转角、原中央巡捕房旧址上的市中心车库 (Down Town Garage)。

    Moalem 先生与其寡母 Sophie Shuker Moalem 夫人同住于江西路374号（2室）。

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C Crawford J

Miss Iraida Petrovna OPARINA, Russian, born
on October 18, 1917 at Blagoveschensk, Amur Province, Si-
beria. According to her own statement, she left Russia
for Manchuria in 1924 and for the following nine years
resided at Harbin together with her mother. Until 1933
she attended a middle school in that .. ", after which
she left for Shanghai arriving here in July of the same
year. Here she is reported to have been employed for
short periods at the Capitol Cinema as an usherette
(in 1933-1934 ) and in the newspaper "Shanghai Zaria" as
a shroff ( 1934 ), after which she attended the "Shang-
hai Zaria's Professional School for Women" ( since 1935
known as the French Professional School ) for about one
year. Since 1935 she has been working as a hairdresser
in the Grosvenor Beauty Parlour, 249 Route Cardinal Mer-
cier.

She is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, Moulmein Road, and at present resides at 479-A
Rue Lafayette. together with her mother, Mrs.
P.H. Oparina, and two sisters of whom one ( Miss N. Opa-
rina) is employed in the Designing Department of the Chi-
na Printing & Finishing Co., and the other ( Miss V. Opa-
rina ) - in the Advertising Department of the "Shanghai
Zaria". Another sister of hers is the wife of E.V. Yablon-
sky, of the Municipal Police.

Miss Oparina holds certificate of good charac-
ter issued by the French Police on 13-6-39 ( No. 243 ).
Nothing detrimental is known in this office re-

    Iraida Petrovna OPARINA 小姐，俄罗斯人，1917年10月18日出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔省布拉戈维申斯克。据其自称，她于1924年离开俄罗斯前往满洲，并在随后的九年里与母亲一起居住在哈尔滨。直到1933年，她一直在那里的一所中学就读*（注：原文此处有残缺 ".. ", 译为“那所...”）*，之后她离开前往上海，并于同年7月抵达。据报，她在此曾短期受雇于大光明电影院 (Capitol Cinema) 担任女引座员（1933-1934年），以及在《上海柴拉报》(Shanghai Zaria) 担任出纳员（1934年），之后她在《上海柴拉报》女子职业学校（1935年起称为法国职业学校）就读约一年。自1935年以来，她一直在霞飞路249号的格罗夫纳美容院 (Grosvenor Beauty Parlour) 担任美发师。

    她已在慕尔鸣路的俄罗斯侨民委员会登记，目前与母亲 P.H. Oparina 夫人及两个姐妹同住于辣斐德路479-A号。其中一个姐妹（N. Oparina 小姐）受雇于中国印染整理公司 (China Printing & Finishing Co.) 的设计部，另一个姐妹（V. Oparina 小姐）受雇于《上海柴拉报》的广告部。她的另一个姐妹是工部局警务处 E.V. Yablonsky 的妻子。

Date June 22, 1939

Subject: MRS E.A. Sudnikoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [签名]

Evgenia Adamovna SUDNIKOFF, Russian born on December 28, 1910 at Nikolsk-Ussouryisk, Maritime Province, Russia. According to her own statement, she left Russia for Manchuria in 1914 together with her parents and subsequently resided in Harbin. She claims to have graduated from a middle school in Harbin in 1926. In 1930 she married a Russian named V.I. Rogozinsky. She is reported to have arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in December, 1934 and to have since been residing in this city. In 1936 she obtained a divorce from her husband and is now known under her maiden name Sudnikoff. In Shanghai she is not known to have any regular employment and is reported to have for the past several years been cohabiting with a Russian Jew named L. Imas, residing at 153 -A Route des Soeurs, Apt. 30, an individual of bad reputation.

Mrs Sudnikoff is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road, and the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau ( Reg. No. 15638 ). She holds certificate of good character No. 240 issued to her by the French Police on 6-6-39.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records concerning the applicant.

（左侧手写批注：Cop）

A. Prokopiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）呈报。转呈人 [签名]

叶夫根尼娅·阿达莫夫娜·苏德尼科夫（Evgenia Adamovna SUDNIKOFF），俄罗斯人，1910年12月28日出生于俄罗斯滨海边疆区乌苏里斯克（Nikolsk-Ussouryisk）。据其自述，她于1914年随父母离开俄罗斯前往满洲，随后居住在哈尔滨。她声称于1926年毕业于哈尔滨的一所中学。1930年，她与一名名为 V.I. 罗戈津斯基（V.I. Rogozinsky）的俄罗斯人结婚。据报，她于1934年12月从哈尔滨抵达上海，并自此居住在本市。1936年，她与丈夫离婚，现恢复使用其娘家姓苏德尼科夫（Sudnikoff）。在上海，据知她没有固定职业，且据报在过去几年中与一名名为 L. 伊马斯（L. Imas）的俄罗斯犹太人同居，该人居住在姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）153-A号30室，是一个名声不佳的人。

苏德尼科夫夫人在穆尔明路（Moulmein Road）的俄罗斯侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局登记在册（注册号 15638）。她持有法国警察机关于1939年6月6日签发给她的第240号品行良好证明书。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何关于该申请人的记录。

（左侧手写批注：副本）

A. 普罗科皮耶夫
副督察

特务科副主任。

Mr. and Mrs. Josef SINGER, German Jewish refugees,
arrived in Shanghai from Europe in the s.s. "Cortellazzo"
on March 18, 1939 and are at present living at 202 Rue
Lafayette.

During their residence in Shanghai they have not
come to the unfavourable notice of the Municipal Police,

form of crime.    In addition to nothing being known
to their detriment, they have not been committed to any
asylum for mental incompetence.

Date June 28, 19 39.

Subject G.L. KOPPANY - Applicant for Certificate of Character

Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

George Luedvig KOPPANY, Hungarian, has
resided in Shanghai since 1921 and during this
period has not been charged with, or convicted of
any criminal offence. Neither has he been committed
to any institution for mental incompetency.

He has, however, been twice convicted in the
Shanghai First Special District Court for breach of
Traffic Regulations.

A man who has lived by his wits for years, he
is regarded in official circles as a man of bad
character with no moral scruples. He is heavily in
debt and although married and the father of a young
child (his wife and child returned to Hungary at the
outbreak of hostilities in 1937) has been living with
Miss Stella SZIRMAY at 270 Yu Yuen Road, premises
housing the Hungarian Inn, owned by the last named
woman, who is reputed to be nothing more nor less
than a third-rate type of demi-mondaine, who arrived
in Shanghai from Bucharest via the night-life haunts
of Constantinople, Algiers, Port Said, Singapore and
Hankow (See contents of attached file).

C. 8%

Ja Pitts
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).

日期：1939年6月28日。

事由 G.L. 科普帕尼（G.L. KOPPANY）- 品行证明书申请人

由副巡官皮茨（D.S. Pitts）呈报 转呈人 〔此处转录不清〕

乔治·卢德维格·科普帕尼（George Luedvig KOPPANY），匈牙利人，
自1921年起居住在上海，在此期间
未被指控或判犯有任何刑事罪行。他也未曾因
精神失常而被送入任何机构。

然而，他曾两次在上海第一特区地方法院
因违反交通法规而被判罪。

此人多年来靠小聪明谋生，在官方圈子里
被视为一个品行恶劣、毫无道德顾忌的人。他
债台高筑，虽然已婚并育有一幼子（他的妻儿在
1937年战事爆发时返回匈牙利），但他一直与
斯特拉·齐尔迈小姐（Miss Stella SZIRMAY）同居，地址为
豫园路270号，该处是匈牙利旅馆，由上述女子拥有，
据称她不过是一个三流的半妓女（demi-mondaine），
她从布加勒斯特出发，途经君士坦丁堡、阿尔及尔、
塞得港、新加坡和汉口的夜生活场所抵达上海
（参见附件档案内容）。

C. 8%

贾·皮茨
副巡官

特务科副主任。

The Commissioner of Police.
Sh. M. P. I

the undersigned begs to apply of a Certificate

to my native country Hungary. I have been

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford ( )

Anatoly Pavlovich JOUROVICK, Russian, born on
March 22, 1912 at Moulin Station, Chinese Eastern Railway.
He received his education in the Railway Technical School
at Harbin graduating in 1930. Some time during 1933 he
arrived in Shanghai from Harbin and in August of the same
year joined the Auxiliary Detachment of the French Police.
In August, 1934 he resigned from the Detachment on his own
accord in order to take up the position of an Anti-Piracy
Guard with the China Navigation Co., Ltd ( Butterfield &
Swire ) in which capacity he served until March, 1938 when
he secured his present position of a superviser with the
Orient Paint, Colour & Varnish Co., Ltd ( Butterfield &
Swire - general agents ), 2200 Pingliang Road. He holds
good references from his former employers.

He resides at the above address together with
his wife, Mrs Irina Petrovna JOUKOVICK nee Neduloff, born
27-8-1914 at Barnaul, Siberia, and their daughter Tatiana,
born 21-3-36 at Harbin. According to her own statement,
she resided at Harbin from 1924 to 1934 during which period
she graduated from the Y.M.C.A. Middle School in 1931 and
from the Y.M.C.A. College - in 1934. She first arrived in
Shanghai from Harbin in 1934 and resided here for about
one year, being employed for various periods with the Mer-
cury Press ( Advertising Department) and with the Model
Dairy as a sales lady. Towards the end of 1935 she left
for Harbin . She returned here in 1937 and from July, 1938
has been employed with Burmeister & Wain, Ltd., 353 Nan-
king Road, as a steno-typist.

阿纳托利·帕夫洛维奇·茹罗维克（Anatoly Pavlovich JOUROVICK），俄罗斯人，1912年3月22日出生于中东铁路穆林站（Moulin Station）。他在哈尔滨铁路技术学校接受教育，于1930年毕业。1933年某时，他从哈尔滨抵达上海，并于同年8月加入法国警察辅助队。1934年8月，他自愿从该队辞职，以便在中国航业公司（Butterfield & Swire，即太古洋行）担任防海盗警卫，在此职位上服务至1938年3月，随后获得现任职位，即在东方油漆颜料清漆有限公司（Orient Paint, Colour & Varnish Co., Ltd，太古洋行为总代理）担任主管，地址为平凉路2200号。他持有前雇主的良好推荐信。

他与妻子伊琳娜·彼得罗夫娜·茹科维奇夫人（Mrs Irina Petrovna JOUKOVICK，婚前姓 Neduloff），1914年8月27日出生于西伯利亚巴尔瑙尔，以及他们的女儿塔蒂亚娜，1936年3月21日出生于哈尔滨，共同居住在上述地址。据其自述，她于1924年至1934年间居住在哈尔滨，在此期间，她于1931年毕业于基督教青年会中学，并于1934年毕业于基督教青年会学院。她于1934年首次从哈尔滨抵达上海，并在此居住约一年，曾在墨丘利出版社（广告部）和模范乳品公司断续任职，担任推销员。1935年底，她前往哈尔滨。她于1937年返回上海，自1938年7月起，受雇于南京路353号的布尔梅斯特与韦恩有限公司（Burmeister & Wain, Ltd.），担任速记打字员。

Made by D.S. Pavloff    Forwarded by C. Crawford. S.P.

Tamara Mihailovna POPOVA, Russian, was born on
February 21, 1914, in Vologda, Russia. According to
her own statement, she left Russia together with her
parents in 1916 and subsequently resided in Harbin
until 1934 after which she proceeded to Peking. In
November 1935 she left Peking for Hankow and after
about four years' residence in the latter city
arrived in Shanghai on June 10, 1939 in the s.s.
"Naruto Maru." It is reported that during her
stay in Hankow she worked as a Ballet dancer in the
International Cabaret and also that she was "kept"
by a foreign resident in that city. At present she
is unemployed and resides at 764/27 Route Bourgeat.
She appears to have certain independent means but it
is also likely that she is still being supported by
her Hankow friend.

The applicant is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning her.

A. O. Pavloff.
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

自述，她于 1916 年随父母离开俄罗斯，随后在哈尔滨
居住至 1934 年，之后前往北平。1935 年 11 月，她离开北平前往汉口，在该市
居住约四年后，于 1939 年 6 月 10 日乘“鸣门丸”号（s.s. "Naruto Maru"）抵达上海。据报，她在
汉口期间曾在国际歌舞厅（International Cabaret）担任芭蕾舞演员，并被该市一名外籍居民“包养”。目前她
失业，居住在勃艮第路（Route Bourgeat）764/27 号。
她似乎有一定的独立经济来源，但也可能仍由其
汉口的朋友资助。

申请人已在茂名南路（Moulmein Road）118/1 号的俄国侨民委员会登记。

Vladimir Leontievitch BOORDA, Russian Jew, was
born on April 2, 1906, at Bargoosin, Transbaikal
Province, Siberia. He is reported to have left
Russia together with his parents in 1913 and to
have subsequently resided in Harbin, Manchuria. In
February 1933 he arrived in Shanghai from Harbin
and in May of the same year secured a position as
a barber with the Navy Y.M.C.A., Szechuen Road. In
January 1938 he left that place of employment on his
own accord and established his own business under
the style Walter's Barber Shop, 1160 Bubbling Well
Road.

His wife, Maria Solomonovna BOORDA, nee Zukkerman,
Russian Jewess, was born on August 16, 1909 in
Chernigov Province, Russia. She married the
applicant in September 1925 at Harbin and has since
been residing together with him. They have one
son, Isaac Vladimirovitch Boorda born on March 28,
1927 at Harbin. At present he is attending the
Public and Thomas Hanbury School for Boys.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
detrimental to the character of V. L. Boorda or any
member of his family.

1906 年 4 月 2 日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省（Transbaikal Province）的巴尔古津（Bargoosin）。据报他于 1913 年随父母离开
俄罗斯，随后居住在满洲哈尔滨。1933 年 2 月，他从哈尔滨抵达上海，并于同年 5 月在四川路海军青年会（Navy Y.M.C.A.）谋得理发师一职。1938 年 1 月，他自愿离职，并在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）1160 号以“沃尔特理发店”（Walter's Barber Shop）的名义开设了自己的店铺。

其妻 Maria Solomonovna BOORDA，娘家姓 Zukkerman，犹太裔俄国人，于 1909 年 8 月 16 日出生于俄罗斯切尔尼戈夫省（Chernigov Province）。她于 1925 年 9 月在哈尔滨与申请人结婚，此后一直与其共同居住。他们育有一子，Isaac Vladimirovitch Boorda，1927 年 3 月 28 日出生于哈尔滨。目前他就读于公立汤玛斯·韩伯瑞男校（Public and Thomas Hanbury School for Boys）。

With reference to the attached application for
certificates of good character for Joseph ISAAC and
Mrs. Lulu Moses SOLOMON, the two applicants are brother
and sister, and reside at Room 10, No.2 Pacific Gardens,
Seymour Road.

Joseph ISAAC was born in Cairo, Egypt, on June 5th,
1895. He later became domiciled in India, and arrived in
Shanghai from that country in 1928. He engaged in
business as a dealer in fancy goods, silks, linens, etc.
and frequently made trips to India, Palestine, Persia,
European countries and Japan in connection with his
business. He was away from Shanghai from 1930 until
1934, and for periods during 1935 and 1938.

He is in possession of a Kingdom of Egypt passport
No.2, issued in Tokyo, on July 20, 1938, on the expiry
of his original passport.

Mrs. Lulu M. SOLOMON was born in Cairo, Egypt, in
1900. She is a British Subject by marriage, but is now
a widow. She arrived in Shanghai during May 1937, and
is supported by her brother, Joseph ISAAC.

Mrs. SOLOMON is in possession of a British
Indian passport, issued at Bombay, India, on February 13,
1935. She is not registered at the British Consulate
in Shanghai, but her passport bears the registration
stamp of the British Consulate in Kobe, Japan.

During their stay in Shanghai, neither applicant
has come to the unfavourable notice of the S.M.Police,

Subject. A.A. Ballod, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Ganssa. S.I

Alexander Alexandrovich BALLOD, Latvian citizen, born on December 1, 1914 at Harbin. According to his own statement, he graduated from a middle school in Harbin in 1931. In October, 1932 he arrived in Shanghai from Harbin and from 1933 to 1935 studied in the Public & Thos. Hanbury School, after which he has been without any regular employment. He resides together with his parents and elder brother at 764 Rue Bourgeat, Apt. 13, at which address he conducts a boarding house.

Applicant's father, Mr. A.P. Ballod, served in the Chinese Maritime Customs at Harbin for 11 years and later at Shanghai for about six years. He retired in 1930.
Mr. E. A. Ballod, brother of the applicant, has been residing in Shanghai since 1936 and formerly was the editor and publisher of a Russian daily entitled "New Trail", which went out of existence in March, 1937 owing to financial difficulties. At present he publishes a Russian weekly magazine entitled "Orient". On 31-3-37 he was charged at the 2nd S.D. Court with assault and was sentenced to 60 days imprisonment or $60.00 fine.

Mr. A.A. Ballod holds Latvian passport No. 5465-E issued on 7-11-31 at Harbin and renewed at the Consulate-General for Finland at Shanghai on 4-11-38.

On 16-6-39 he was issued by the French Police a certificate of good character ( No. 1943/A ).

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records concerning this person.

A. Prokofiev

Shanghai, on July 27th, 1939.

To the

Commissioner of Police,

Shanghai.

The undersigned Otto SABEL, born on October 14th,
1919 at Vienna, staying now in Shanghai, 138 Ward Road,
begs to apply for a "Certificate of good Conduct".

I came to Shanghai on January 29th, 1939 by
the steamer "Conte Verde" of the Lloyd Triestino.

I am working in the Office of one of the German
Jewish Refugee Centers and I need the Certificate
of good Conduct for being able to do the application
for entering Australia.

I have, since I am in Shanghai, never been
in prison or in a lunatic asylum and had
none incident with the Police in Shanghai.

Yours faithfully

Otto Sabel

Date July 25, 1939.

Subject S. Zukerman, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S. Pavloff Forwarded by C. Crawford. S.I.

Samuel Abramovitch ZUKERMAN, Russian Jew,
was born on April 19, 1874 in Warsaw, Poland.
According to his own statement, he left Russia in
1917 and subsequently resided in Harbin, Manchuria,
where he was engaged in commercial activities until
1937 after which he came to Shanghai. At present
he is an agent for different fashion-magazines printed
in Paris and New York, and resides at 129/15 Avenue
Haig together with his son-in-law, Mr. Boorda,
proprietor of Walter's Barber Shop, 1160 Bubbling
Well Road.

His wife, Zivia Israelovna ZUKERMAN, nee
Tchernomorskaya, Russian Jewess, was born in 1888
in Tchernigoff Province, Russia. She married the
applicant in 1919 in Harbin and they have since been
residing together.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police
records concerning these persons.

（左侧批注：SR）
（左侧批注：25/7.）

A. G. Pavloff.
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

REPORT
Date July 28, 1939.

Subject V.Z. Trefimoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S. Pavloff Forwarded by C. Crawford.

Vassily Zinovievitch TREFILOFF,
Russian, was born on August 6, 1907 in Simbirsk,
Russia. He is reported to have left Russia
together with his parents in 1918 and to have
subsequently resided in Harbin, Manchuria. In
January 1930 he arrived in Shanghai from Harbin
and until May of the same year was employed as a
watchman by the Foreign Y.M.C.A., Bubbling Well
Road. From June 1930 to February 1933 he was employed
as a bodyguard by Dr. Luh Zang An, 307, Route Cardinal
Mercier. He left that place of employment owing to
ill health, and in March 1933 secured a position as
a ticket inspector with the China General Omnibus
Company. In October of the same year he resigned
in order to take up a position as a Sanitary Overseer
with the French Municipal Health Department, where
he is still employed at present.

The applicant is registered with the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moumein Road.

While in Shanghai he did not come to the
notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any
activities of an undesirable nature.

D.B.C.
28/7

D.C. (Special Branch)

I.G. Pollock
D. S.

瓦西里·齐诺维耶维奇·特雷菲洛夫（Vassily Zinovievitch TREFILOFF），
俄罗斯人，1907年8月6日出生于俄罗斯辛比尔斯克（Simbirsk）。
据报他于1918年与父母一同离开俄罗斯，
随后居住在满洲哈尔滨。1930年1月他从哈尔滨
抵达上海，直至同年5月受雇于静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）
外国青年会（Foreign Y.M.C.A.）担任看守。1930年6月至1933年2月，
他受雇于麦神父路（Route Cardinal Mercier）307号陆章安（Luh Zang An，音译）博士
担任保镖。后因健康原因离职，并于1933年3月在
中华汽车公司（China General Omnibus Company）谋得查票员一职。
同年10月辞职，以便在法公董局卫生局（French Municipal Health Department）
担任卫生督察，目前仍在此任职。

申请人已在慕尔鸣路（Moumein Road）118/1号
俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。

在上海期间，申请人未因任何不良性质的活动
引起工部局警务处的注意。

D.B.C.
7月28日

D.C. (特别课)

I.G. 波洛克（I.G. Pollock）
D. S.

and 1928 he was employed as a clerk with Shainin & Co.

ing, Nanking Road. From April 1938, he has been
employed as a bookkeeper at the "Rennaissance" Cafe,
795, Avenue Joffre.

to the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with
any activities of an undesirable nature.

The Superintendent,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I arrived in Shanghai on 31st December 1938 and
was registered by the I.C. under No. 8989. I never have asked, nor
have I obtained from the I.C., or from anybody else, support.

My date of birth is March 18, 1884, in Vienna
( Austria ). By profession I am a specialist in machinery.
It is my intention to emigrate to the United States, for which
purpose I need your certificate of good behaviour during my stay
here. I shall thank you to kindly issue such a certificate, show-
ing that my conduct during my stay at Shanghai was correct and that
I have had no police record.

By way of reference I beg to enclose herewith a
letter from Mr. E. Kann, who has been residing in China for the
past 40 years and who is wellknown locally.

TThanking you in anticipation for your kind attention
I beg to remain, Sir,

Very respectfully Yours,

Fedor Vassilievitch BASSOFF, Russian, was born
on September 8, 1893, in Samara Province, Russia.
According to his own statement he resided in Urumchi,
Sinkiang Province from 1920 to 1927 and later in
Tientsin until March 1930, afterwards coming to
Shanghai. From June 1930 to October 1932 he was
employed as a bullion escort with the China & South
Seas Bank. In October 1932 he purchased a haberdashery store known as "Russky Bazaar", 1013 Avenue
Joffre. In 1935 he left that store for a butchery
and grocery, which he established at 1238 Avenue
Joffre. The latter enterprise was disposed of by
Bassoff in May, 1937, since when he has not been
engaged in any business.
There is nothing in the Municipal Police
records detrimental to his character.

D.S.
10/8

A.G. Pavloff.
D. S.

D.C.(Special Branch)

Subject Karl GROEGER - Requesting the Issuance of "Good Conduct" Certificates

Made by ____ and ____ Forwarded by D.S.I. Wittinsky

With reference to the three attached applications submitted by Mr. K. Groeger, requesting the issuance of "good conduct" certificates in respect of the undermentioned persons, the following particulars have been obtained:-

1) Mr. Karl Groeger, German Jew, divorced, formerly owner of a leather factory, born in Vienna, Germany, on the 3-1-1892, arrived in Shanghai on the 1-5-39 on the s/s "President Doumer". His present address is 181 Route Remi, French Concession.

2) Mr. Emanuel Schmerler, German Jew, married, tailor, born in Vienna, Germany, on the 26-1-1908, arrived in Shanghai, accompanied by his wife, on the 3-5-39 on the s/s "Gneisenau". He is at present in Hong Kong with his wife.

3) Mrs. Franziska Schmerler, German Jewess, born in Vienna, Germany, on the 28-6-1907.

Mrs. F. Schmerler is the former wife (divorced) of Mr. K. Groeger and departed for Hong Kong with her husband on the 25-7-39 on the s/s "Gneisenau". The couple's address in Shanghai was 181 Route Remi, French Concession.

It was elicited, that the "good conduct" certificates are required by the above named persons in order to obtain immigration visas from the Authorities concerned for the purpose of settling down in Melbourne, Australia.

During the course of enquiries it was found, that the

2) Emanuel Schmerler 先生，德籍犹太人，已婚，裁缝，1908年1月26日出生于德国维也纳，于1939年5月3日携妻子乘“格奈森瑙”号轮船（s/s "Gneisenau"）抵达上海。目前他与妻子在香港。

3) Franziska Schmerler 女士，德籍犹太女性，1907年6月28日出生于德国维也纳。

F. Schmerler 女士是 K. Groeger 先生的前妻（离异），并于1939年7月25日与其丈夫乘“格奈森瑙”号轮船前往香港。夫妇二人在上海的住址为法租界雷米路181号。

Subject M.V. Gedich, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by. D.S. Pavloff. Forwarded by C. Crawford I.S.

Morris Vicentievitch GEDICH, Russian, was born
on January 14, 1910 in Harbin, Manchuria. He first
arrived in Shanghai in 1918 together with his mother
and for two years attended the Thomas Hanbury School.
In the end of 1919 he returned to Harbin. In March
1927 he proceeded to Chefoo where he entered the Yih
Wen Commercial College. In January 1929 he left the
college and arrived in Shanghai during the same month.
Soon afterwards he obtained a position as a service
manager with Taylor Garage Ltd. In June 1930 he
established his own Service Station in Route de Say
Zoong. Between August 1932 and July 1933 he was
employed as 3rd Engineer on board the various ships
of Moller & Company. Later he worked as a salesman with
Lemcke Motor Sales, 361 Avenue Foch, and during 1936
in the same capacity with the China Motors, 702 Bubbling
Well Road. From September 1937 to September 1938 he
was employed as 3rd Engineer on board the s.s. "Nils
Moller", after which he has been without fixed employment.
At present he resides at House 4, 147 Avenue Haig.

The applicant is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning him.

i.a. Pavloff -
D. S.

A.C. (Special Branch)

Subject I.V. Hackel, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.I.

Igor Vladimirovich Hackel ( or Gackel ), Russian,
was born on August 30, 1913 at Harbin and is the son of a
school teacher. According to his own statement, he gradu-
ated from a middle school in Harbin in 1934 and for the
following three years studied in the St. Vladimir's Insti-
tute ( Chemical Department ) in that city.

He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on 1-2-38 in
the S.S. "Koten Maru". From 5-2-38 to 31-7-38 he served
in the Russian Auxiliary Detachment of the French Police.
Leaving the service on his own accord he was employed as
an apprentice trainer in the Columbia & Great Western Rid-
ing Academy, 470 Great Western Road, from 1-8-38 to 30-12-38.
His next place of employment was the Tisco Service, 633
Avenue Foch ( Vulcanizing Co ) where he worked as an ap-
prentice for a very short period, after which he was em-
ployed as a kennelman with Heylock & Pratt, 501 Liangchow
Road, for about two months ( April-June, 1939 ). Since that
time he has been unemployed.

Hackel holds a certificate issued by the Harbin
Police in March, 1935 to the effect that according to Natu-
ralization Certificate No. 12136, Character Kuei ( 歸 ),
issued by the Ministry of Interior in October, 1927, he is
a naturalized Chinese citizen.

On 25-8-39 he was issued by the French Police a
certificate of good character ( No. 2701/A ). Enquiries
from his former employers do not elicit any information
which could reflect unfavourably on his character and there
is nothing in the Municipal Police records regarding him.

Igor Vladimirovich Hackel（或 Gackel），俄罗斯人，1913年8月30日出生于哈尔滨，系一名教师之子。据其自述，他于1934年毕业于哈尔滨的一所中学，并在随后的三年里在该市的圣弗拉基米尔学院（St. Vladimir's Institute）化学系学习。

他于1938年2月1日乘坐“高天丸”号轮船（S.S. "Koten Maru"）从哈尔滨抵达上海。1938年2月5日至1938年7月31日，他在法国警察局的俄罗斯辅助分队服役。自愿离职后，他于1938年8月1日至1938年12月30日在大西路470号的哥伦比亚与大西部骑术学校（Columbia & Great Western Riding Academy）担任学徒教练。他的下一份工作地点是福煦路633号的 Tisco Service（Vulcanizing Co），他在那里做了很短时间的学徒，之后在凉州路501号的 Heylock & Pratt 公司担任养犬员约两个月（1939年4月至6月）。此后他一直失业。

Hackel 持有哈尔滨警察局于1935年3月签发的一份证书，内容指出根据内政部于1927年10月签发的归化证书第12136号，类别“归”字，他是一名归化中国公民。

1939年8月25日，法国警察局向他签发了品行良好证书（编号 2701/A）。向其前雇主查询未获得任何对其品行不利的信息，且工部局警务处档案中关于他没有任何记录。

Subject G.V. Cherdynzeff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Frokofiev. Forwarded by R. W. Mac Auley D.S.I.

Gennady Victorovich CHERDYNZEFF, naturalized Chinese citizen of Russian origin, born on July 3, 1897 at Maryinsk, Tomsk province, Siberia. According to his own statement, he left Russia for China in 1921 and after a short stay in Peking proceeded to Tientsin where he resided for the following several years. From Tientsin he visited the United States ( 1922-1923 ) and Australia ( 1926-1927 ).

He arrived in Shanghai in October, 1929 from Tientsin where he is reported to have been employed with J. Blum & Co., ( Maison de Parfumerie ). In Shanghai he has been engaged in commercial pursuits as manager of the Far Eastern Credit Co., Financiers & Fur Dealers, at present located at 46 Route de Grouchy. The business was established some time towards the end of 1929 and is reported to belong to the applicant's wife, Mrs T.I. Cherdynzeff nee Kulaieff, daughter of I.A. Kulaieff, a wealthy merchant who formerly resided in Tientsin and is believed to be in the U.S.A. at present. It appears that the enterprise has not been very successful during the past few years and is in the state of liquidation now.

Cherdynzeff holds Naturalization Certificate No. 89 Character "Hung" ( 洪 ) issued on November 7, 1936 by the Ministry of Interior, Nanking. At present he resides at 46 Route de Grouchy together with his wife and daughter, aged 34 and 10 years, respectively.

On 18-1-39 Cherdynzeff was issued by the French

根纳季·维克托罗维奇·切尔登泽夫（Gennady Victorovich CHERDYNZEFF），俄裔归化中国公民，1897年7月3日出生于西伯利亚托木斯克省马林斯克（Maryinsk）。据其自述，他于1921年离开俄国前往中国，在北京短暂停留后前往天津，并在那里居住了随后的几年。从天津出发，他曾访问美国（1922-1923年）和澳大利亚（1926-1927年）。

他于1929年10月从天津抵达上海，据报道他在天津受雇于 J. Blum & Co.（香水店）。在上海，他从事商业活动，担任远东信贷公司（Far Eastern Credit Co.）、金融家及皮草商行的经理，该公司目前位于格鲁希路（Route de Grouchy）46号。该企业成立于1929年底的某个时候，据报道属于申请人的妻子 T.I. Cherdynzeff 夫人（婚前姓 Kulaieff），她是 I.A. Kulaieff 的女儿，I.A. Kulaieff 是一位富商，以前居住在天津，据信目前在美国。看来该企业在过去几年中经营不太成功，目前处于清算状态。

Cherdynzeff 持有南京内政部于1936年11月7日颁发的第89号归化证书，中文名为“洪”。目前他与妻子和女儿居住在格鲁希路46号，她们分别为34岁和10岁。

Subject J. Gerber, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by R. W. Mac Culie D.S.I.

Julius Gerber, German citizen of Jewish origin,
born on April 11, 1904 at Virsitz, Germany. He holds pas-
port no. 2/9050/38 issued on 16-1-39 at Berlin. A mer-
chant by occupation he left Berlin for Italy in May, 1939
and later proceeded to the Far East arriving in this ci-
ty on 19-5-39 in the s.s. "Scharnhorst". Here he re-
sided at 120 Thorne Road until 1-8-39 when he removed to
149 Yuen Ming Yuen Road, Room 41, his present address.

His wife, Else Margarete Gerber nee Engel,
born on January 7, 1907 at Koeln, holder of passport
no. 2/651/38 issued on 16-1-39 at Berlin, arrived in
Shanghai together with her husband. She is a dressmaker
by occupation and assists her husband in conducting a
small ladies hat and dressmaking business they established
at 149 Yuen Ming Yuen Road in the beginning of August
last.

They are both registered at the local German
Consulate-General and with the International Committee for
Granting Relief to Refugees from Europe ( identification
cards Nos. 5772 and 5734, respectively ).

While in Shanghai they did not come to Police
notice.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch )

Benzion Israeleovich WINOKUR ( or Vinokour ),
Soviet citizen of Jewish origin, born on November 9, 1895
at Priukov, Poltava province, South Russia. According to
his own statement, he worked as a tailor until the out-
break of the Great War when he joined the Russian army.
In 1915 he was taken prisoner by the Germans and until
1922 worked as a farm labourer in various places in Ger-
many. For the following 17 years he resided in Berlin.
He holds passport No. 002824 issued by the Soviet Consu-
late-General in Berlin on 6-4-35, in which he is des-
cribed as a merchant.

In January, 1939 he left Berlin for Italy and
later proceeded to the Far East arriving in this city on
22-2-39 in the s.s. " Conte Biancamano ". Here he re-
sided at 150 Wayside Road for about six weeks, after which
he removed to 291 Macgregor Road, his present address.

Mrs Margarita Avgustovna Winokur nee Wernecke,
naturalized Soviet citizen of German-Jewish origin, born
on 16-10-1903 at Karlshorst b/Berlin, holds passport
No. 004292 issued by the Soviet Consulate-General at Ber-
lin on 23-12-38. She arrived in Shanghai together with
her husband and son named Horst B. Winokur, born on 14-5-23
at Berlin. ( Soviet passport No. 004180 of 11-4-38, Berlin ).

The Winokur couple conduct a boarding house at
291 Macgregor Road, while their son is reported to be work-
ing as an apprentice in a garage located at 1677-81 Ave-
nue Road.

They are registered with the local Soviet Consu-

Marianne L a n g e r
335, Wayside Road
Shanghai,
September 17th, 1939

The Shanghai Municipal Council
Shanghai

Re Application for a Certificate of Good Conduct

Sirs,
I have received the permission to enter Kenya (British East
Africa) and have applied to the British Consulate General here for
a visa. I was told there I have to present them a certificate of
good conduct issued by a Shanghai local authority.
I should be very much obliged to you, if you had the kindness of
giving me that certificate.
I was born in Vienna on May 10th 1891. My maiden-name was Marianne
Steiner. On April 10th 1920 I got married to Dr. Paul Rosenberg,
Manager of the Union Baugesellschaft, Vienna. My husband died on
May 15th 1936. Since December 29th 1938 I have been married to
Mr. Moritz Langer, former employee of the "Gremium der Wiener Kauf-
mannschaft". I left Austria on July 7th 1939 and arrived in Shanghai
on August 8th. First I lived in the house 611, Lalny Road, then I
moved to 557, East Seward Road, and since September 10th I have been
living in 335, Wayside Road.
I want to leave for Kenya as soon as possible and, therefore, should
be grateful to you, if you would give me that certificate of good
conduct at your earliest convenience.
I am, Sirs,
Yours respectfully,
Marianne Langer

Marianne Langer

REPORT
Date September 18, 1939
Subject A. M. Vinokooroff, applicant for a certificate of character.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by R. W. MacLii D.S.I.

Arcady Mihailovich VINOKOOROFF, Russian, born
on August 27, 1914 in Irkutsk Province, Siberia. He is
reported to have left Russia for Manchuria in 1922 and
subsequently to have resided in Harbin where he graduated
from a local middle school in 1933. In November of the
same year he arrived in Shanghai from Harbin. Here he work-
ed casually until June, 1934 when he secured a position as
a ticket inspector in the China General Omnibus Company
where he is still employed.

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants
Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, and the Shanghai City Go-
vernment Police Bureau ( Reg. No. 14212 ). At present he
resides at 1248 Rue Lafayette, House 5, together with his
aunt, Mrs A.A. Kamensky, and his brother, I.M. Vinokooroff,
who has been employed with the China General Omnibus Co.,
for about three years in the same capacity.

On 12-9-39 the applicant was issued by the
French Police a certificate of good character ( No. 258 ).

While in Shanghai he did not come to Police
notice.

It appears from the applicant's own statement,
that his friends, Mr. and Mrs S. Lescheff, who reside at
7 George Street, S.I. of Dominion Road, Auckland, New Zea-
land, will assist him in the matter of migrating to that
country.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

阿尔卡季·米哈伊洛维奇·维诺库罗夫（Arcady Mihailovich VINOKOOROFF），俄国人，1914年8月27日出生于西伯利亚伊尔库茨克省。据报他于1922年离开俄国前往满洲，随后居住在哈尔滨，并于1933年毕业于当地一所中学。同年11月，他从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此之后，他打零工直至1934年6月，当时他在中国公共汽车公司（China General Omnibus Company）获得了一份查票员的职位，并至今仍受雇于此。

他在莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）118/1号的俄国侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局（注册号 14212）进行了登记。目前，他与姑母 A.A. 卡缅斯基夫人（Mrs A.A. Kamensky）及兄弟 I.M. 维诺库罗夫（I.M. Vinokooroff）同住于拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）1248号5室，其兄弟在中国公共汽车公司担任相同职务已约三年。

1939年9月12日，法国警察向其颁发了品行良好证明书（第258号）。

在上海期间，他未引起警方注意。

根据申请人自述，其朋友 S. 莱谢夫先生和夫人（Mr. and Mrs S. Lescheff）居住在新西兰奥克兰多米尼恩路（Dominion Road）S.I. 乔治街7号，将在其移居该国事宜上提供协助。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
警探长

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Sir,

Having been instructed by my London Office to proceed on business to Buenos Aires I herewith beg to make application for a Certificate of Good Conduct, as required by the Authorities of the Argentine Republic.

For your information, I would say that I arrived in Shanghai in May 1937 and have been registered since that time at H.M.Consulate General, having in the meantime made several long visits away from Shanghai, including one of seven months' duration, to England and return.

As references I would give H.M.Consulate General (in particular Mr. G.W.Creighton), the newly-appointed Crown Advocate (Mr.John McNeill), the Chartered Bank of I.A.& China, The Mercantile Bank of India,Ltd., the National City Bank of New York,and others.

Furthermore, I should appreciate it if this Certificate could be made to cover my wife, Mrs. Therese Rose Howell, and my seventeen-year old daughter, Mavis Esther Beatrice Howell, both of whom sailed from home on 26th August in the s.s. "Viceroy of India", being due to arrive in Shanghai about the end of this week, but neither of whom have ever been in China before.

I shall be glad if you will kindly advise me of the cost of such Certificate, and if you require any further information.

I am, Sir,

Yours faithfully,

〔此处为手写签名〕

I.Ll. Howell
General Manager for the Far East

奉伦敦办事处指示，我将前往布宜诺斯艾利斯办理公务，特此申请阿根廷共和国当局所要求的品行良好证明书。

供贵处参考，我于1937年5月抵达上海，并自此在英国领事馆总领事馆登记，其间曾多次长时间离开上海，包括一次为期七个月往返英国的行程。

作为推荐人，我可提供英国领事馆总领事馆（特别是 G.W. Creighton 先生）、新任王室律师（John McNeill 先生）、印度亚洲汇理银行（Chartered Bank of I.A.& China）、印度商业银行有限公司（The Mercantile Bank of India,Ltd.）、纽约花旗银行（National City Bank of New York）及其他机构。

此外，如该证明书能涵盖我的妻子特蕾泽·罗斯·豪厄尔夫人（Mrs. Therese Rose Howell）和我十七岁的女儿梅维斯·埃丝特·比阿特丽斯·豪厄尔（Mavis Esther Beatrice Howell），我将不胜感激，她们二人于8月26日乘坐“印度副王”号轮船（s.s. "Viceroy of India"）从家中启航，预计将于本周末抵达上海，但她们此前均未到过中国。

如蒙告知此类证明书的费用，以及是否还需要其他信息，我将不胜感激。

此致，
先生，

您忠实的，

〔此处为手写签名〕

I.Ll. 豪厄尔
远东总经理
BUNGE & CO.LIMITED,
